1.zh: 亚伯拉罕的后裔，大卫的子孙，耶稣基督的家谱：
1.en: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

1.zh: 亚伯拉罕生以撒；以撒生雅各；雅各生犹大和他的弟兄；
1.en: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

1.zh: 犹大从她玛氏生法勒斯和谢拉；法勒斯生希斯 ；希斯 生亚兰；
1.en: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

1.zh: 亚兰生亚米拿达；亚米拿达生拿顺；拿顺生撒门；
1.en: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

1.zh: 撒门从喇合氏生波阿斯；波阿斯从路得氏生俄备得；俄备得生耶西；
1.en: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

1.zh: 耶西生大卫王。 大卫从乌利亚的妻子生所罗门；
1.en: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

1.zh: 所罗门生罗波安；罗波安生亚比雅；亚比雅生亚撒；
1.en: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

1.zh: 亚撒生约沙法；约沙法生约兰； 约兰生乌西雅；
1.en: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

1.zh: 乌西雅生约坦；约坦生亚哈斯；亚哈斯生希西家；
1.en: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

1.zh: 希西家生玛拿西；玛拿西生亚们；亚们生约西亚；
1.en: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

1.zh: 百姓被迁到巴比伦的时候，约西亚生耶哥尼雅和他的弟兄。
1.en: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

1.zh: 迁到巴比伦之后，耶哥尼雅生撒拉铁；撒拉铁生所罗巴伯；
1.en: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

1.zh: 所罗巴伯生亚比玉；亚比玉生以利亚敬；以利亚敬生亚所；
1.en: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

1.zh: 亚所生撒督；撒督生亚金；亚金生以律；
1.en: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

1.zh: 以律生以利亚撒；以利亚撒生马但；马但生雅各；
1.en: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

1.zh: 雅各生约瑟，就是马利亚的丈夫。那称为基督的耶稣是从马利亚生的。
1.en: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

1.zh: 这样，从亚伯拉罕到大卫共有十四代；从大卫到迁至巴比伦的时候也有十四代；从迁至巴比伦的时候到基督又有十四代。
1.en: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

1.zh: 耶稣基督降生的事记在下面：他母亲马利亚已经许配了约瑟，还没有迎娶，马利亚就从圣灵怀了孕。
1.en: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

1.zh: 她丈夫约瑟是个义人，不愿意明明地羞辱她，想要暗暗地把她休了。
1.en: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

1.zh: 正思念这事的时候，有主的使者向他梦中显现，[说]：「大卫的子孙约瑟，不要怕！只管娶过你的妻子马利亚来，因她所怀的孕是从圣灵来的。
1.en: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

1.zh: 她将要生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫耶稣，因他要将自己的百姓从罪恶里救出来。」
1.en: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”

1.zh: 这一切的事成就是要应验主借先知所说的话，
1.en: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

1.zh: 说： 必有童女怀孕生子； 人要称他的名为以马内利。 （以马内利翻出来就是「　神与我们同在」。）
1.en: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”

1.zh: 约瑟醒了，起来，就遵着主使者的吩咐把妻子娶过来；
1.en: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

1.zh: 只是没有和她同房，等她生了儿子，就给他起名叫耶稣。
1.en: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

2.zh: 当希律王的时候，耶稣生在犹太的伯利恒。有几个博士从东方来到耶路撒冷，[说]：
2.en: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

2.zh: 「那生下来作犹太人之王的在哪里？我们在东方看见他的星，特来拜他。」
2.en: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”

2.zh: 希律王听见了，就心里不安；耶路撒冷合城的人也都不安。
2.en: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

2.zh: 他就召齐了祭司长和民间的文士，问他们说：「基督当生在何处？」
2.en: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

2.zh: 他们回答说：「在犹太的伯利恒。因为有先知记着，说：
2.en: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

2.zh: 犹大地的伯利恒啊， 你在犹大诸城中并不是最小的； 因为将来有一位君王要从你那里出来， 牧养我以色列民。」
2.en: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah; for out of you shall come a governor who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”

2.zh: 当下，希律暗暗地召了博士来，细问那星是什么时候出现的，
2.en: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

2.zh: 就差他们往伯利恒去，说：「你们去仔细寻访那小孩子，寻到了就来报信，我也好去拜他。」
2.en: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”

2.zh: 他们听见王的话就去了。在东方所看见的那星忽然在他们前头行，直行到小孩子的地方，就在上头停住了。
2.en: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.

2.zh: 他们看见那星，就大大地欢喜；
2.en: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

2.zh: 进了房子，看见小孩子和他母亲马利亚，就俯伏拜那小孩子，揭开宝盒，拿黄金、乳香、没药为礼物献给他。
2.en: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

2.zh: 博士因为在梦中被[主]指示不要回去见希律，就从别的路回本地去了。
2.en: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

2.zh: 他们去后，有主的使者向约瑟梦中显现，说：「起来！带着小孩子同他母亲逃往埃及，住在那里，等我吩咐你；因为希律必寻找小孩子，要除灭他。」
2.en: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”

2.zh: 约瑟就起来，夜间带着小孩子和他母亲往埃及去，
2.en: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,

2.zh: 住在那里，直到希律死了。这是要应验主借先知所说的话，说：「我从埃及召出我的儿子来。」
2.en: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”

2.zh: 希律见自己被博士愚弄，就大大发怒，差人将伯利恒城里并四境所有的男孩，照着他向博士仔细查问的时候，凡两岁以里的，都杀尽了。
2.en: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

2.zh: 这就应了先知耶利米的话，说：
2.en: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

2.zh: 在拉玛听见号咷大哭的声音， 是拉结哭她儿女， 不肯受安慰， 因为他们都不在了。
2.en: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”

2.zh: 希律死了以后，有主的使者在埃及向约瑟梦中显现，说：
2.en: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

2.zh: 「起来！带着小孩子和他母亲往以色列地去，因为要害小孩子性命的人已经死了。」
2.en: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”

2.zh: 约瑟就起来，把小孩子和他母亲带到以色列地去；
2.en: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

2.zh: 只因听见亚基老接着他父亲希律作了犹太王，就怕往那里去，又在梦中被[主]指示，便往加利利境内去了，
2.en: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

2.zh: 到了一座城，名叫拿撒勒，就住在那里。这是要应验先知所说，他将称为拿撒勒人的话了。
2.en: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.

3.zh: 那时，有施洗的约翰出来，在犹太的旷野传道，说：
3.en: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
“Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”

3.zh: 这人就是先知以赛亚所说的。他说：「在旷野有人声喊着说： 预备主的道， 修直他的路！」
3.en: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”

3.zh: 这约翰身穿骆驼毛的衣服，腰束皮带，吃的是蝗虫、野蜜。
3.en: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

3.zh: 那时，耶路撒冷和犹太全地，并约旦河一带地方的人，都出去到约翰那里，
3.en: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

3.zh: 承认他们的罪，在约旦河里受他的洗。
3.en: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

3.zh: 约翰看见许多法利赛人和撒都该人也来受洗，就对他们说：「毒蛇的种类！谁指示你们逃避将来的愤怒呢？
3.en: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

3.zh: 你们要结出果子来，与悔改的心相称。
3.en: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!

3.zh: 不要自己心里说：『有亚伯拉罕为我们的祖宗。』我告诉你们，　神能从这些石头中给亚伯拉罕兴起子孙来。
3.en: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

3.zh: 现在斧子已经放在树根上，凡不结好果子的树就砍下来，丢在火里。
3.en: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.

3.zh: 我是用水给你们施洗，叫你们悔改。但那在我以后来的，能力比我更大，我就是给他提鞋也不配。他要用圣灵与火给你们施洗。
3.en: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

3.zh: 他手里拿着簸箕，要扬净他的场，把麦子收在仓里，把糠用不灭的火烧尽了。」
3.en: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”

3.zh: 当下，耶稣从加利利来到约旦河，见了约翰，要受他的洗。
3.en: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

3.zh: 约翰想要拦住他，说：「我当受你的洗，你反倒上我这里来吗？」
3.en: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”

3.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你暂且许我，因为我们理当这样尽诸般的义。」于是约翰许了他。
3.en: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.

3.zh: 耶稣受了洗，随即从水里上来。天忽然为他开了，他就看见　神的灵仿佛鸽子降下，落在他身上。
3.en: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

3.zh: 从天上有声音说：「这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。」
3.en: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”

4.zh: 当时，耶稣被[圣]灵引到旷野，受魔鬼的试探。
4.en: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

4.zh: 他禁食四十昼夜，后来就饿了。
4.en: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

4.zh: 那试探人的进前来，对他说：「你若是　神的儿子，可以吩咐这些石头变成食物。」
4.en: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

4.zh: 耶稣却回答说：「[经上]记着说： 人活着，不是单靠食物， 乃是靠　神口里所出的一切话。」
4.en: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”

4.zh: 魔鬼就带他进了圣城，叫他站在殿顶上，
4.en: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

4.zh: 对他说：「你若是　神的儿子，可以跳下去，因为[经上]记着说： 主要为你吩咐他的使者 用手托着你， 免得你的脚碰在石头上。」
4.en: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”

4.zh: 耶稣对他说：「[经上]又记着说：『不可试探主—你的　神。』」
4.en: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”

4.zh: 魔鬼又带他上了一座最高的山，将世上的万国与万国的荣华都指给他看，
4.en: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

4.zh: 对他说：「你若俯伏拜我，我就把这一切都赐给你。」
4.en: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”

4.zh: 耶稣说：「撒但，退去吧！因为[经上]记着说： 当拜主—你的　神， 单要事奉他。」
4.en: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

4.zh: 于是，魔鬼离了耶稣，有天使来伺候他。
4.en: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

4.zh: 耶稣听见约翰下了监，就退到加利利去；
4.en: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

4.zh: 后又离开拿撒勒，往迦百农去，就住在那里。那地方靠海，在西布伦和拿弗他利的边界上。
4.en: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

4.zh: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，
4.en: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

4.zh: 说： 西布伦地，拿弗他利地， 就是沿海的路，约旦河外， 外邦人的加利利地—
4.en: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

4.zh: 那坐在黑暗里的百姓看见了大光； 坐在死荫之地的人有光发现照着他们。
4.en: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”

4.zh: 从那时候，耶稣就传起道来，说：「天国近了，你们应当悔改！」
4.en: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”

4.zh: 耶稣在加利利海边行走，看见弟兄二人，就是那称呼彼得的西门和他兄弟安得烈，在海里撒网；他们本是打鱼的。
4.en: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

4.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「来跟从我，我要叫你们得人如得鱼一样。」
4.en: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”

4.zh: 他们就立刻舍了网，跟从了他。
4.en: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

4.zh: 从那里往前走，又看见弟兄二人，就是西庇太的儿子雅各和他兄弟约翰，同他们的父亲西庇太在船上补网，耶稣就招呼他们，
4.en: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

4.zh: 他们立刻舍了船，别了父亲，跟从了耶稣。
4.en: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

4.zh: 耶稣走遍加利利，在各会堂里教训人，传天国的福音，医治百姓各样的病症。
4.en: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

4.zh: 他的名声就传遍了叙利亚。那里的人把一切害病的，就是害各样疾病、各样疼痛的和被鬼附的、癫痫的、瘫痪的，都带了来，耶稣就治好了他们。
4.en: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

4.zh: 当下，有许多人从加利利、低加坡里、耶路撒冷、犹太、约旦河外来跟着他。
4.en: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

5.zh: 耶稣看见这许多的人，就上了山，既已坐下，门徒到他跟前来，
5.en: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

5.zh: 他就开口教训他们，说：
5.en: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

5.zh: 虚心的人有福了！ 因为天国是他们的。
5.en: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

5.zh: 哀恸的人有福了！ 因为他们必得安慰。
5.en: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

5.zh: 温柔的人有福了！ 因为他们必承受地土。
5.en: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.

5.zh: 饥渴慕义的人有福了！ 因为他们必得饱足。
5.en: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.

5.zh: 怜恤人的人有福了！ 因为他们必蒙怜恤。
5.en: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

5.zh: 清心的人有福了！ 因为他们必得见　神。
5.en: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

5.zh: 使人和睦的人有福了！ 因为他们必称为　神的儿子。
5.en: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

5.zh: 为义受逼迫的人有福了！ 因为天国是他们的。
5.en: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

5.zh: 「人若因我辱骂你们，逼迫你们，捏造各样坏话毁谤你们，你们就有福了！
5.en: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

5.zh: 应当欢喜快乐，因为你们在天上的赏赐是大的。在你们以前的先知，人也是这样逼迫他们。」
5.en: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

5.zh: 「你们是世上的盐。盐若失了味，怎能叫它再咸呢？以后无用，不过丢在外面，被人践踏了。
5.en: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

5.zh: 你们是世上的光。城造在山上是不能隐藏的。
5.en: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

5.zh: 人点灯，不放在斗底下，是放在灯台上，就照亮一家的人。
5.en: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.

5.zh: 你们的光也当这样照在人前，叫他们看见你们的好行为，便将荣耀归给你们在天上的父。」
5.en: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

5.zh: 「莫想我来要废掉律法和先知。我来不是要废掉，乃是要成全。
5.en: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.

5.zh: 我实在告诉你们，就是到天地都废去了，律法的一点一画也不能废去，都要成全。
5.en: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

5.zh: 所以，无论何人废掉这诫命中最小的一条，又教训人这样做，他在天国要称为最小的。但无论何人遵行这诫命，又教训人遵行，他在天国要称为大的。
5.en: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

5.zh: 我告诉你们，你们的义若不胜于文士和法利赛人的义，断不能进天国。」
5.en: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

5.zh: 「你们听见有吩咐古人的话，说：『不可杀人』；[又说]：『凡杀人的难免受审判。』
5.en: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’

5.zh: 只是我告诉你们，凡向弟兄动怒的，难免受审断；凡骂弟兄是拉加的，难免公会[的审断]；凡骂弟兄是魔利的，难免地狱的火。
5.en: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.

5.zh: 所以，你在祭坛上献礼物的时候，若想起弟兄向你怀怨，
5.en: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,

5.zh: 就把礼物留在坛前，先去同弟兄和好，然后来献礼物。
5.en: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

5.zh: 你同告你的对头还在路上，就赶紧与他和息，恐怕他把你送给审判官，审判官交付衙役，你就下在监里了。
5.en: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

5.zh: 我实在告诉你，若有一文钱没有还清，你断不能从那里出来。」
5.en: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.

5.zh: 「你们听见有话说：『不可奸淫。』
5.en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’

5.zh: 只是我告诉你们，凡看见妇女就动淫念的，这人心里已经与她犯奸淫了。
5.en: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

5.zh: 若是你的右眼叫你跌倒，就剜出来丢掉，宁可失去百体中的一体，不叫全身丢在地狱里。
5.en: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

5.zh: 若是右手叫你跌倒，就砍下来丢掉，宁可失去百体中的一体，不叫全身下入地狱。」
5.en: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

5.zh: 「又有话说：『人若休妻，就当给她休书。』
5.en: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’

5.zh: 只是我告诉你们，凡休妻的，若不是为淫乱的缘故，就是叫她作淫妇了；人若娶这被休的妇人，也是犯奸淫了。」
5.en: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.

5.zh: 「你们又听见有吩咐古人的话，说：『不可背誓，所起的誓总要向主谨守。』
5.en: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’

5.zh: 只是我告诉你们，什么誓都不可起。不可指着天起誓，因为天是　神的座位；
5.en: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;

5.zh: 不可指着地起誓，因为地是他的脚凳；也不可指着耶路撒冷起誓，因为耶路撒冷是大君的京城；
5.en: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

5.zh: 又不可指着你的头起誓，因为你不能使一根头发变黑变白了。
5.en: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.

5.zh: 你们的话，是，就说是；不是，就说不是；若再多说就是出于那恶者。」
5.en: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.

5.zh: 「你们听见有话说：『以眼还眼，以牙还牙。』
5.en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’

5.zh: 只是我告诉你们，不要与恶人作对。有人打你的右脸，连左脸也转过来由他打；
5.en: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

5.zh: 有人想要告你，要拿你的里衣，连外衣也由他拿去；
5.en: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

5.zh: 有人强逼你走一里路，你就同他走二里；
5.en: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

5.zh: 有求你的，就给他；有向你借贷的，不可推辞。」
5.en: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

5.zh: 「你们听见有话说：『当爱你的邻舍，恨你的仇敌。』
5.en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

5.zh: 只是我告诉你们，要爱你们的仇敌，为那逼迫你们的祷告。
5.en: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

5.zh: [这样]就可以作你们天父的儿子；因为他叫日头照好人，也照歹人；降雨给义人，也给不义的人。
5.en: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

5.zh: 你们若[单]爱那爱你们的人，有什么赏赐呢？就是税吏不也是这样行吗？
5.en: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

5.zh: 你们若单请你弟兄的安，比人有什么长处呢？就是外邦人不也是这样行吗？
5.en: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

5.zh: 所以，你们要完全，像你们的天父完全一样。」
5.en: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

6.zh: 「你们要小心，不可将善事行在人的面前，故意叫他们看见，若是这样，就不能得你们天父的赏赐了。
6.en: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

6.zh: 所以，你施舍的时候，不可在你前面吹号，像那假冒为善的人在会堂里和街道上所行的，故意要得人的荣耀。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。
6.en: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

6.zh: 你施舍的时候，不要叫左手知道右手所做的，
6.en: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,

6.zh: 要叫你施舍的事行在暗中。你父在暗中察看，必然报答你。」
6.en: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

6.zh: 「你们祷告的时候，不可像那假冒为善的人，爱站在会堂里和十字路口上祷告，故意叫人看见。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。
6.en: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

6.zh: 你祷告的时候，要进你的内屋，关上门，祷告你在暗中的父；你父在暗中察看，必然报答你。
6.en: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

6.zh: 你们祷告，不可像外邦人，用许多重复话，他们以为话多了必蒙垂听。
6.en: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

6.zh: 你们不可效法他们；因为你们没有祈求以先，你们所需用的，你们的父早已知道了。
6.en: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

6.zh: 所以，你们祷告要这样说： 我们在天上的父： 愿人都尊你的名为圣。
6.en: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

6.zh: 愿你的国降临； 愿你的旨意行在地上， 如同行在天上。
6.en: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

6.zh: 我们日用的饮食，今日赐给我们。
6.en: Give us today our daily bread.

6.zh: 免我们的债， 如同我们免了人的债。
6.en: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

6.zh: 不叫我们遇见试探； 救我们脱离凶恶。 因为国度、权柄、荣耀，全是你的， 直到永远。阿们！
6.en: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

6.zh: 「你们饶恕人的过犯，你们的天父也必饶恕你们[的过犯]；
6.en: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

6.zh: 你们不饶恕人的过犯，你们的[天]父也必不饶恕你们的过犯。」
6.en: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

6.zh: 「你们禁食的时候，不可像那假冒为善的人，脸上带着愁容；因为他们把脸弄得难看，故意叫人看出他们是禁食。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。
6.en: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

6.zh: 你禁食的时候，要梳头洗脸，
6.en: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

6.zh: 不叫人看出你禁食来，只叫你暗中的父看见；你父在暗中察看，必然报答你。」
6.en: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.

6.zh: 「不要为自己积攒财宝在地上；地上有虫子咬，能锈坏，也有贼挖窟窿来偷。
6.en: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

6.zh: 只要积攒财宝在天上；天上没有虫子咬，不能锈坏，也没有贼挖窟窿来偷。
6.en: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;

6.zh: 因为你的财宝在哪里，你的心也在那里。」
6.en: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

6.zh: 「眼睛就是身上的灯。你的眼睛若了亮，全身就光明；
6.en: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

6.zh: 你的眼睛若昏花，全身就黑暗。你里头的光若黑暗了，那黑暗是何等大呢！」
6.en: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

6.zh: 「一个人不能事奉两个主；不是恶这个、爱那个，就是重这个、轻那个。你们不能又事奉　神，又事奉玛门。」
6.en: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.

6.zh: 「所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑吃什么，喝什么；为身体忧虑穿什么。生命不胜于饮食吗？身体不胜于衣裳吗？
6.en: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

6.zh: 你们看那天上的飞鸟，也不种，也不收，也不积蓄在仓里，你们的天父尚且养活它。你们不比飞鸟贵重得多吗？
6.en: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

6.zh: 你们哪一个能用思虑使寿数多加一刻呢？
6.en: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

6.zh: 何必为衣裳忧虑呢？你想野地里的百合花怎么长起来；它也不劳苦，也不纺线。
6.en: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,

6.zh: 然而我告诉你们，就是所罗门极荣华的时候，他所穿戴的，还不如这花一朵呢！
6.en: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

6.zh: 你们这小信的人哪！野地里的草今天还在，明天就丢在炉里，　神还给它这样的妆饰，何况你们呢！
6.en: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

6.zh: 所以，不要忧虑说，吃什么？喝什么？穿什么？
6.en: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’

6.zh: 这都是外邦人所求的。你们需用的这一切东西，你们的天父是知道的。
6.en: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

6.zh: 你们要先求他的国和他的义，这些东西都要加给你们了。
6.en: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

6.zh: 所以，不要为明天忧虑，因为明天自有明天的忧虑；一天的难处一天当就够了。」
6.en: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

7.zh: 「你们不要论断人，免得你们被论断。
7.en: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.

7.zh: 因为你们怎样论断人，也必怎样被论断；你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们。
7.en: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

7.zh: 为什么看见你弟兄眼中有刺，却不想自己眼中有梁木呢？
7.en: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

7.zh: 你自己眼中有梁木，怎能对你弟兄说：『容我去掉你眼中的刺』呢？
7.en: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?

7.zh: 你这假冒为善的人！先去掉自己眼中的梁木，然后才能看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。
7.en: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.

7.zh: 不要把圣物给狗，也不要把你们的珍珠丢在猪前，恐怕它践踏了珍珠，转过来咬你们。」
7.en: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

7.zh: 「你们祈求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。
7.en: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

7.zh: 因为凡祈求的，就得着；寻找的，就寻见；叩门的，就给他开门。
7.en: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

7.zh: 你们中间谁有儿子求饼，反给他石头呢？
7.en: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

7.zh: 求鱼，反给他蛇呢？
7.en: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

7.zh: 你们虽然不好，尚且知道拿好东西给儿女，何况你们在天上的父，岂不更把好东西给求他的人吗？
7.en: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

7.zh: 所以，无论何事，你们愿意人怎样待你们，你们也要怎样待人，因为这就是律法和先知[的道理]。」
7.en: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

7.zh: 「你们要进窄门。因为引到灭亡，那门是宽的，路是大的，进去的人也多；
7.en: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.

7.zh: 引到[永]生，那门是窄的，路是小的，找着的人也少。」
7.en: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.

7.zh: 「你们要防备假先知。他们到你们这里来，外面披着羊皮，里面却是残暴的狼。
7.en: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

7.zh: 凭着他们的果子，就可以认出他们来。荆棘上岂能摘葡萄呢？蒺藜里岂能摘无花果呢？
7.en: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?

7.zh: 这样，凡好树都结好果子，惟独坏树结坏果子。
7.en: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.

7.zh: 好树不能结坏果子；坏树不能结好果子。
7.en: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.

7.zh: 凡不结好果子的树就砍下来，丢在火里。
7.en: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

7.zh: 所以，凭着他们的果子就可以认出他们来。」
7.en: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

7.zh: 「凡称呼我『主啊，主啊』的人不能都进天国；惟独遵行我天父旨意的人才能进去。
7.en: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

7.zh: 当那日必有许多人对我说：『主啊，主啊，我们不是奉你的名传道，奉你的名赶鬼，奉你的名行许多异能吗？』
7.en: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’

7.zh: 我就明明地告诉他们说：『我从来不认识你们，你们这些作恶的人，离开我去吧！』」
7.en: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’

7.zh: 「所以，凡听见我这话就去行的，好比一个聪明人，把房子盖在磐石上；
7.en: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.

7.zh: 雨淋，水冲，风吹，撞着那房子，房子总不倒塌，因为根基立在磐石上。
7.en: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

7.zh: 凡听见我这话不去行的，好比一个无知的人，把房子盖在沙土上；
7.en: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

7.zh: 雨淋，水冲，风吹，撞着那房子，房子就倒塌了，并且倒塌得很大。」
7.en: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”

7.zh: 耶稣讲完了这些话，众人都希奇他的教训；
7.en: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

7.zh: 因为他教训他们，正像有权柄的人，不像他们的文士。
7.en: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

8.zh: 耶稣下了山，有许多人跟着他。
8.en: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

8.zh: 有一个长大麻风的来拜他，说：「主若肯，必能叫我洁净了。」
8.en: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

8.zh: 耶稣伸手摸他，说：「我肯，你洁净了吧！」他的大麻风立刻就洁净了。
8.en: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

8.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你切不可告诉人，只要去把身体给祭司察看，献上摩西所吩咐的礼物，对众人作证据。」
8.en: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

8.zh: 耶稣进了迦百农，有一个百夫长进前来，求他说：
8.en: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,

8.zh: 「主啊，我的仆人害瘫痪病，躺在家里，甚是疼苦。」
8.en: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”

8.zh: 耶稣说：「我去医治他。」
8.en: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”

8.zh: 百夫长回答说：「主啊，你到我舍下，我不敢当；只要你说一句话，我的仆人就必好了。
8.en: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

8.zh: 因为我在人的权下，也有兵在我以下；对这个说『去！』他就去；对那个说『来！』他就来；对我的仆人说：『你做这事！』他就去做。」
8.en: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

8.zh: 耶稣听见就希奇，对跟从的人说：「我实在告诉你们，这么大的信心，就是在以色列中，我也没有遇见过。
8.en: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

8.zh: 我又告诉你们，从东从西，将有许多人来，在天国里与亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各一同坐席；
8.en: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

8.zh: 惟有本国的子民竟被赶到外边黑暗里去，在那里必要哀哭切齿了。」
8.en: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

8.zh: 耶稣对百夫长说：「你回去吧！照你的信心，给你成全了。」那时，他的仆人就好了。
8.en: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.

8.zh: 耶稣到了彼得家里，见彼得的岳母害热病躺着。
8.en: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.

8.zh: 耶稣把她的手一摸，热就退了；她就起来服事耶稣。
8.en: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.

8.zh: 到了晚上，有人带着许多被鬼附的来到耶稣跟前，他只用一句话就把鬼都赶出去，并且治好了一切有病的人。
8.en: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,

8.zh: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，说： 他代替我们的软弱， 担当我们的疾病。
8.en: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”

8.zh: 耶稣见许多人围着他，就吩咐渡到那边去。
8.en: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

8.zh: 有一个文士来，对他说：「夫子，你无论往哪里去，我要跟从你。」
8.en: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

8.zh: 耶稣说：「狐狸有洞，天空的飞鸟有窝，人子却没有枕头的地方。」
8.en: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”

8.zh: 又有一个门徒对耶稣说：「主啊，容我先回去埋葬我的父亲。」
8.en: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

8.zh: 耶稣说：「任凭死人埋葬他们的死人；你跟从我吧！」
8.en: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”

8.zh: 耶稣上了船，门徒跟着他。
8.en: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

8.zh: 海里忽然起了暴风，甚至船被波浪掩盖；耶稣却睡着了。
8.en: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.

8.zh: 门徒来叫醒了他，说：「主啊，救我们，我们丧命啦！」
8.en: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

8.zh: 耶稣说：「你们这小信的人哪，为什么胆怯呢？」于是起来，斥责风和海，风和海就大大地平静了。
8.en: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

8.zh: 众人希奇，说：「这是怎样的人？连风和海也听从他了！」
8.en: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

8.zh: 耶稣既渡到那边去，来到加大拉人的地方，就有两个被鬼附的人从坟茔里出来迎着他，极其凶猛，甚至没有人能从那条路上经过。
8.en: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

8.zh: 他们喊着说：「　神的儿子，我们与你有什么相干？时候还没有到，你就上这里来叫我们受苦吗？」
8.en: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”

8.zh: 离他们很远，有一大群猪吃食。
8.en: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

8.zh: 鬼就央求耶稣，说：「若把我们赶出去，就打发我们进入猪群吧！」
8.en: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”

8.zh: 耶稣说：「去吧！」鬼就出来，进入猪群。全群忽然闯下山崖，投在海里淹死了。
8.en: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.

8.zh: 放猪的就逃跑进城，将这一切事和被鬼附的人所遭遇的都告诉人。
8.en: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

8.zh: 合城的人都出来迎见耶稣，既见了就央求他离开他们的境界。
8.en: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

9.zh: 耶稣上了船，渡过[海]，来到自己的城里。
9.en: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.

9.zh: 有人用褥子抬着一个瘫子到耶稣跟前来。耶稣见他们的信心，就对瘫子说：「小子，放心吧！你的罪赦了。」
9.en: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

9.zh: 有几个文士心里说：「这个人说僭妄的话了。」
9.en: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”

9.zh: 耶稣知道他们的心意，就说：「你们为什么心里怀着恶念呢？
9.en: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?

9.zh: 或说『你的罪赦了』，或说『你起来行走』，哪一样容易呢？
9.en: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?

9.zh: 但要叫你们知道，人子在地上有赦罪的权柄」；就对瘫子说：「起来！拿你的褥子回家去吧。」
9.en: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”

9.zh: 那人就起来，回家去了。
9.en: He arose and departed to his house.

9.zh: 众人看见都惊奇，就归荣耀与　神，因为他将这样的权柄赐给人。
9.en: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

9.zh: 耶稣从那里往前走，看见一个人名叫马太，坐在税关上，就对他说：「你跟从我来。」他就起来跟从了耶稣。
9.en: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.

9.zh: 耶稣在屋里坐席的时候，有好些税吏和罪人来，与耶稣和他的门徒一同坐席。
9.en: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

9.zh: 法利赛人看见，就对耶稣的门徒说：「你们的先生为什么和税吏并罪人一同吃饭呢？」
9.en: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

9.zh: 耶稣听见，就说：「康健的人用不着医生，有病的人才用得着。
9.en: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

9.zh: [经上说]：『我喜爱怜恤，不喜爱祭祀。』这句话的意思，你们且去揣摩。我来本不是召义人，乃是召罪人。」
9.en: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

9.zh: 那时，约翰的门徒来见耶稣，说：「我们和法利赛人常常禁食，你的门徒倒不禁食，这是为什么呢？」
9.en: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

9.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「新郎和陪伴之人同在的时候，陪伴之人岂能哀恸呢？但日子将到，新郎要离开他们，那时候他们就要禁食。
9.en: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

9.zh: 没有人把新布补在旧衣服上；因为所补上的反带坏了那衣服，破的就更大了。
9.en: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

9.zh: 也没有人把新酒装在旧皮袋里；若是这样，皮袋就裂开，酒漏出来，连皮袋也坏了。惟独把新酒装在新皮袋里，两样就都保全了。」
9.en: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”

9.zh: 耶稣说这话的时候，有一个管[会堂的]来拜他，说：「我女儿刚才死了，求你去按手在她身上，她就必活了。」
9.en: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

9.zh: 耶稣便起来跟着他去；门徒也跟了去。
9.en: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

9.zh: 有一个女人，患了十二年的血漏，来到耶稣背后，摸他的衣裳 子；
9.en: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

9.zh: 因为她心里说：「我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊愈。」
9.en: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

9.zh: 耶稣转过来，看见她，就说：「女儿，放心！你的信救了你。」从那时候，女人就痊愈了。
9.en: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

9.zh: 耶稣到了管[会堂]的家里，看见有吹手，又有许多人乱嚷，
9.en: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,

9.zh: 就说：「退去吧！这闺女不是死了，是睡着了。」他们就嗤笑他。
9.en: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.

9.zh: 众人既被撵出，耶稣就进去，拉着闺女的手，闺女便起来了。
9.en: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

9.zh: 于是这风声传遍了那地方。
9.en: The report of this went out into all that land.

9.zh: 耶稣从那里往前走，有两个瞎子跟着他，喊叫说：「大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！」
9.en: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”

9.zh: 耶稣进了房子，瞎子就来到他跟前。耶稣说：「你们信我能做这事吗？」他们说：「主啊，我们信。」
9.en: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”

9.zh: 耶稣就摸他们的眼睛，说：「照着你们的信给你们成全了吧。」
9.en: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”

9.zh: 他们的眼睛就开了。耶稣切切地嘱咐他们说：「你们要小心，不可叫人知道。」
9.en: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”

9.zh: 他们出去，竟把他的名声传遍了那地方。
9.en: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

9.zh: 他们出去的时候，有人将鬼所附的一个哑巴带到耶稣跟前来。
9.en: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

9.zh: 鬼被赶出去，哑巴就说出话来。众人都希奇，说：「在以色列中，从来没有见过这样的事。」
9.en: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

9.zh: 法利赛人却说：「他是靠着鬼王赶鬼。」
9.en: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”

9.zh: 耶稣走遍各城各乡，在会堂里教训人，宣讲天国的福音，又医治各样的病症。
9.en: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

9.zh: 他看见许多的人，就怜悯他们；因为他们困苦流离，如同羊没有牧人一般。
9.en: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

9.zh: 于是对门徒说：「要收的庄稼多，做工的人少。
9.en: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

9.zh: 所以，你们当求庄稼的主打发工人出去收他的庄稼。」
9.en: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

10.zh: 耶稣叫了十二个门徒来，给他们权柄，能赶逐污鬼，并医治各样的病症。
10.en: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

10.zh: 这十二使徒的名：头一个叫西门（又称彼得），还有他兄弟安得烈，西庇太的儿子雅各和雅各的兄弟约翰，
10.en: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

10.zh: 腓力和巴多罗买，多马和税吏马太，亚勒腓的儿子雅各，和达太，
10.en: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;

10.zh: 奋锐党的西门，还有卖耶稣的加略人犹大。
10.en: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

10.zh: 耶稣差这十二个人去，吩咐他们说：「外邦人的路，你们不要走；撒马利亚人的城，你们不要进；
10.en: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.

10.zh: 宁可往以色列家迷失的羊那里去。
10.en: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

10.zh: 随走随传，说『天国近了！』
10.en: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’

10.zh: 医治病人，叫死人复活，叫长大麻风的洁净，把鬼赶出去。你们白白地得来，也要白白地舍去。
10.en: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

10.zh: 腰袋里不要带金银铜钱；
10.en: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.

10.zh: 行路不要带口袋；不要带两件褂子，也不要带鞋和拐杖。因为工人得饮食是应当的。
10.en: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

10.zh: 你们无论进哪一城，哪一村，要打听那里谁是好人，就住在他家，直住到走的时候。
10.en: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.

10.zh: 进他家里去，要请他的安。
10.en: As you enter into the household, greet it.

10.zh: 那家若配得平安，你们所求的平安就必临到那家；若不配得，你们所求的平安仍归你们。
10.en: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.

10.zh: 凡不接待你们、不听你们话的人，你们离开那家，或是那城的时候，就把脚上的尘土跺下去。
10.en: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.

10.zh: 我实在告诉你们，当审判的日子，所多玛和蛾摩拉所受的，比那城还容易受呢！」
10.en: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

10.zh: 「我差你们去，如同羊进入狼群；所以你们要灵巧像蛇，驯良像鸽子。
10.en: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.

10.zh: 你们要防备人；因为他们要把你们交给公会，也要在会堂里鞭打你们，
10.en: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

10.zh: 并且你们要为我的缘故被送到诸侯君王面前，对他们和外邦人作见证。
10.en: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

10.zh: 你们被交的时候，不要思虑怎样说话，或说什么话。到那时候，必赐给你们当说的话；
10.en: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

10.zh: 因为不是你们自己说的，乃是你们父的灵在你们里头说的。
10.en: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

10.zh: 弟兄要把弟兄，父亲要把儿子，送到死地；儿女要与父母为敌，害死他们；
10.en: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

10.zh: 并且你们要为我的名被众人恨恶。惟有忍耐到底的必然得救。
10.en: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

10.zh: 有人在这城里逼迫你们，就逃到那城里去。我实在告诉你们，以色列的城邑，你们还没有走遍，人子就到了。
10.en: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.

10.zh: 学生不能高过先生；仆人不能高过主人。
10.en: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

10.zh: 学生和先生一样，仆人和主人一样，也就罢了。人既骂家主是别西卜，何况他的家人呢？」
10.en: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!

10.zh: 「所以，不要怕他们；因为掩盖的事没有不露出来的，隐藏的事没有不被人知道的。
10.en: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.

10.zh: 我在暗中告诉你们的，你们要在明处说出来；你们耳中所听的，要在房上宣扬出来。
10.en: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

10.zh: 那杀身体、不能杀灵魂的，不要怕他们；惟有能把身体和灵魂都灭在地狱里的，正要怕他。
10.en: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.

10.zh: 两个麻雀不是卖一分银子吗？若是你们的父不许，一个也不能掉在地上；
10.en: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.

10.zh: 就是你们的头发也都被数过了。
10.en: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

10.zh: 所以，不要惧怕，你们比许多麻雀还贵重！」
10.en: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

10.zh: 「凡在人面前认我的，我在我天上的父面前也必认他；
10.en: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.

10.zh: 凡在人面前不认我的，我在我天上的父面前也必不认他。」
10.en: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.

10.zh: 「你们不要想我来是叫地上太平；我来并不是叫地上太平，乃是叫地上动刀兵。
10.en: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.

10.zh: 因为我来是叫 人与父亲生疏， 女儿与母亲生疏， 媳妇与婆婆生疏。
10.en: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

10.zh: 人的仇敌就是自己家里的人。
10.en: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.

10.zh: 「爱父母过于爱我的，不配作我的门徒；爱儿女过于爱我的，不配作我的门徒；
10.en: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.

10.zh: 不背着他的十字架跟从我的，也不配作我的门徒。
10.en: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.

10.zh: 得着生命的，将要失丧生命；为我失丧生命的，将要得着生命。」
10.en: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

10.zh: 「人接待你们就是接待我；接待我就是接待那差我来的。
10.en: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

10.zh: 人因为先知的名接待先知，必得先知所得的赏赐；人因为义人的名接待义人，必得义人所得的赏赐。
10.en: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

10.zh: 无论何人，因为门徒的名，只把一杯凉水给这小子里的一个喝，我实在告诉你们，这人不能不得赏赐。」
10.en: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”

11.zh: 耶稣吩咐完了十二个门徒，就离开那里，往各城去传道、教训人。
11.en: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

11.zh: 约翰在监里听见基督所做的事，就打发[两个]门徒去，
11.en: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples

11.zh: 问他说：「那将要来的是你吗？还是我们等候别人呢？」
11.en: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”

11.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们去，把所听见、所看见的事告诉约翰。
11.en: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

11.zh: 就是瞎子看见，瘸子行走，长大麻风的洁净，聋子听见，死人复活，穷人有福音传给他们。
11.en: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

11.zh: 凡不因我跌倒的就有福了！」
11.en: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

11.zh: 他们走的时候，耶稣就对众人讲论约翰说：「你们从前出到旷野是要看什么呢？要看风吹动的芦苇吗？
11.en: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

11.zh: 你们出去到底是要看什么？要看穿细软[衣服]的人吗？那穿细软[衣服]的人是在王宫里。
11.en: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

11.zh: 你们出去究竟是为什么？是要看先知吗？我告诉你们，是的，他比先知大多了。
11.en: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

11.zh: [经上]记着说：『我要差遣我的使者在你前面预备道路』，所说的就是这个人。
11.en: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

11.zh: 我实在告诉你们，凡妇人所生的，没有一个兴起来大过施洗约翰的；然而天国里最小的比他还大。
11.en: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

11.zh: 从施洗约翰的时候到如今，天国是努力进入的，努力的人就得着了。
11.en: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

11.zh: 因为众先知和律法说预言，到约翰为止。
11.en: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

11.zh: 你们若肯领受，这人就是那应当来的以利亚。
11.en: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

11.zh: 有耳可听的，就应当听！
11.en: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

11.zh: 我可用什么比这世代呢？好像孩童坐在街市上招呼同伴，说：
11.en: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

11.zh: 我们向你们吹笛， 你们不跳舞； 我们向你们举哀， 你们不捶胸。
11.en: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’

11.zh: 约翰来了，也不吃也不喝，人就说他是被鬼附着的；
11.en: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

11.zh: 人子来了，也吃也喝，人又说他是贪食好酒的人，是税吏和罪人的朋友。但智慧之子总以智慧为是。」
11.en: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”

11.zh: 耶稣在诸城中行了许多异能，那些城的人终不悔改，就在那时候责备他们，说：
11.en: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.

11.zh: 「哥拉汛哪，你有祸了！伯赛大啊，你有祸了！因为在你们中间所行的异能，若行在泰尔、西顿，他们早已披麻蒙灰悔改了。
11.en: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

11.zh: 但我告诉你们，当审判的日子，泰尔、西顿所受的，比你们还容易受呢！
11.en: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

11.zh: 迦百农啊，你已经升到天上，将来必坠落阴间；因为在你那里所行的异能，若行在所多玛，它还可以存到今日。
11.en: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.

11.zh: 但我告诉你们，当审判的日子，所多玛所受的，比你还容易受呢！」
11.en: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”

11.zh: 那时，耶稣说：「父啊，天地的主，我感谢你！因为你将这些事向聪明通达人就藏起来，向婴孩就显出来。
11.en: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

11.zh: 父啊，是的，因为你的美意本是如此。
11.en: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

11.zh: 一切所有的，都是我父交付我的；除了父，没有人知道子；除了子和子所愿意指示的，没有人知道父。
11.en: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

11.zh: 凡劳苦担重担的人可以到我这里来，我就使你们得安息。
11.en: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

11.zh: 我心里柔和谦卑，你们当负我的轭，学我的样式；这样，你们心里就必得享安息。
11.en: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

11.zh: 因为我的轭是容易的，我的担子是轻省的。」
11.en: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

12.zh: 那时，耶稣在安息日从麦地经过。他的门徒饿了，就掐起麦穗来吃。
12.en: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

12.zh: 法利赛人看见，就对耶稣说：「看哪，你的门徒做安息日不可做的事了！」
12.en: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

12.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「[经上记着]大卫和跟从他的人饥饿之时所做的事，你们没有念过吗？
12.en: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:

12.zh: 他怎么进了　神的殿，吃了陈设饼，这饼不是他和跟从他的人可以吃得，惟独祭司才可以吃。
12.en: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

12.zh: 再者，律法上所记的，当安息日，祭司在殿里犯了安息日还是没有罪，你们没有念过吗？
12.en: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?

12.zh: 但我告诉你们，在这里有一人比殿更大。
12.en: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

12.zh: 『我喜爱怜恤，不喜爱祭祀。』你们若明白这话的意思，就不将无罪的当作有罪的了。
12.en: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.

12.zh: 因为人子是安息日的主。」
12.en: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

12.zh: 耶稣离开那地方，进了一个会堂。
12.en: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.

12.zh: 那里有一个人枯干了一只手。有人问耶稣说：「安息日治病可以不可以？」意思是要控告他。
12.en: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.

12.zh: 耶稣说：「你们中间谁有一只羊，当安息日掉在坑里，不把它抓住、拉上来呢？
12.en: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?

12.zh: 人比羊何等贵重呢！所以，在安息日做善事是可以的。」
12.en: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

12.zh: 于是对那人说：「伸出手来！」他把手一伸，手就复了原，和那只手一样。
12.en: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

12.zh: 法利赛人出去，商议怎样可以除灭耶稣。
12.en: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

12.zh: 耶稣知道了，就离开那里，有许多人跟着他。他把其中有病的人都治好了；
12.en: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

12.zh: 又嘱咐他们，不要给他传名。
12.en: and commanded them that they should not make him known,

12.zh: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，说：
12.en: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

12.zh: 看哪！我的仆人， 我所拣选、所亲爱、心里所喜悦的， 我要将我的灵赐给他； 他必将公理传给外邦。
12.en: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

12.zh: 他不争竞，不喧嚷； 街上也没有人听见他的声音。
12.en: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

12.zh: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断； 将残的灯火，他不吹灭； 等他施行公理，叫公理得胜。
12.en: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

12.zh: 外邦人都要仰望他的名。
12.en: In his name, the nations will hope.”

12.zh: 当下，有人将一个被鬼附着、又瞎又哑的人带到耶稣那里，耶稣就医治他，甚至那哑巴又能说话，又能看见。
12.en: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

12.zh: 众人都惊奇，说：「这不是大卫的子孙吗？」
12.en: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

12.zh: 但法利赛人听见，就说：「这个人赶鬼，无非是靠着鬼王别西卜啊。」
12.en: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

12.zh: 耶稣知道他们的意念，就对他们说：「凡一国自相纷争，就成为荒场；一城一家自相纷争，必站立不住；
12.en: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

12.zh: 若撒但赶逐撒但，就是自相纷争，他的国怎能站得住呢？
12.en: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

12.zh: 我若靠着别西卜赶鬼，你们的子弟赶鬼又靠着谁呢？这样，他们就要断定你们的是非。
12.en: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

12.zh: 我若靠着　神的灵赶鬼，这就是　神的国临到你们了。
12.en: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

12.zh: 人怎能进壮士家里，抢夺他的家具呢？除非先捆住那壮士，才可以抢夺他的[家财]。
12.en: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

12.zh: 不与我相合的，就是敌我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。」
12.en: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

12.zh: 所以我告诉你们：「人一切的罪和亵渎的话都可得赦免，惟独亵渎圣灵，总不得赦免。
12.en: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

12.zh: 凡说话干犯人子的，还可得赦免；惟独说话干犯圣灵的，今世来世总不得赦免。」
12.en: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.

12.zh: 「你们或以为树好，果子也好；树坏，果子也坏；因为看果子就可以知道树。
12.en: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

12.zh: 毒蛇的种类！你们既是恶人，怎能说出好话来呢？因为心里所充满的，口里就说出来。
12.en: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

12.zh: 善人从他[心里]所存的善就发出善来；恶人从他[心里]所存的恶就发出恶来。
12.en: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

12.zh: 我又告诉你们，凡人所说的闲话，当审判的日子，必要句句供出来；
12.en: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

12.zh: 因为要凭你的话定你为义，也要凭你的话定你有罪。」
12.en: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

12.zh: 当时，有几个文士和法利赛人对耶稣说：「夫子，我们愿意你显个神迹给我们看。」
12.en: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

12.zh: 耶稣回答说：「一个邪恶淫乱的世代求看神迹，除了先知约拿的神迹以外，再没有神迹给他们看。
12.en: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

12.zh: 约拿三日三夜在大鱼肚腹中，人子也要这样三日三夜在地里头。
12.en: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

12.zh: 当审判的时候，尼尼微人要起来定这世代的罪，因为尼尼微人听了约拿所传的就悔改了。看哪，在这里有一人比约拿更大！
12.en: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

12.zh: 当审判的时候，南方的女王要起来定这世代的罪；因为她从地极而来，要听所罗门的智慧话。看哪，在这里有一人比所罗门更大！」
12.en: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

12.zh: 「污鬼离了人身，就在无水之地过来过去，寻求安歇[之处]，却寻不着。
12.en: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.

12.zh: 于是说：『我要回到我所出来的屋里去。』到了，就看见里面空闲，打扫干净，修饰好了，
12.en: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

12.zh: 便去另带了七个比自己更恶的鬼来，都进去住在那里。那人末后的景况比先前更不好了。这邪恶的世代也要如此。」
12.en: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

12.zh: 耶稣还对众人说话的时候，不料他母亲和他弟兄站在外边，要与他说话。
12.en: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

12.zh: 有人告诉他说：「看哪，你母亲和你弟兄站在外边，要与你说话。」
12.en: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

12.zh: 他却回答那人说：「谁是我的母亲？谁是我的弟兄？」
12.en: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

12.zh: 就伸手指着门徒，说：「看哪，我的母亲，我的弟兄。
12.en: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

12.zh: 凡遵行我天父旨意的人，就是我的弟兄姊妹和母亲了。」
12.en: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

13.zh: 当那一天，耶稣从房子里出来，坐在海边。
13.en: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.

13.zh: 有许多人到他那里聚集，他只得上船坐下，众人都站在岸上。
13.en: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.

13.zh: 他用比喻对他们讲许多道理，说：「有一个撒种的出去撒种；
13.en: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

13.zh: 撒的时候，有落在路旁的，飞鸟来吃尽了；
13.en: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

13.zh: 有落在土浅石头地上的，土既不深，发苗最快，
13.en: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

13.zh: 日头出来一晒，因为没有根，就枯干了；
13.en: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

13.zh: 有落在荆棘里的，荆棘长起来，把它挤住了；
13.en: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

13.zh: 又有落在好土里的，就结实，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。
13.en: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

13.zh: 有耳[可听]的，就应当听！」
13.en: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

13.zh: 门徒进前来，问耶稣说：「对众人讲话，为什么用比喻呢？」
13.en: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

13.zh: 耶稣回答说：「因为天国的奥秘只叫你们知道，不叫他们知道。
13.en: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

13.zh: 凡有的，还要加给他，叫他有余；凡没有的，连他所有的，也要夺去。
13.en: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

13.zh: 所以我用比喻对他们讲，是因他们看也看不见，听也听不见，也不明白。
13.en: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

13.zh: 在他们身上，正应了以赛亚的预言，说： 你们听是要听见，却不明白； 看是要看见，却不晓得；
13.en: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;

13.zh: 因为这百姓油蒙了心， 耳朵发沉， 眼睛闭着， 恐怕眼睛看见， 耳朵听见， 心里明白，回转过来， 我就医治他们。
13.en: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’

13.zh: 「但你们的眼睛是有福的，因为看见了；你们的耳朵也是有福的，因为听见了。
13.en: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

13.zh: 我实在告诉你们，从前有许多先知和义人要看你们所看的，却没有看见，要听你们所听的，却没有听见。」
13.en: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

13.zh: 「所以，你们当听这撒种的比喻。
13.en: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

13.zh: 凡听见天国道理不明白的，那恶者就来，把所撒在他心里的夺了去；这就是撒在路旁的了。
13.en: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

13.zh: 撒在石头地上的，就是人听了道，当下欢喜领受，
13.en: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;

13.zh: 只因心里没有根，不过是暂时的，及至为道遭了患难，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。
13.en: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

13.zh: 撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，后来有世上的思虑、钱财的迷惑把道挤住了，不能结实。
13.en: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

13.zh: 撒在好地上的，就是人听道明白了，后来结实，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。」
13.en: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”

13.zh: 耶稣又设个比喻对他们说：「天国好像人撒好种在田里，
13.en: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

13.zh: 及至人睡觉的时候，有仇敌来，将稗子撒在麦子里就走了。
13.en: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

13.zh: 到长苗吐穗的时候，稗子也显出来。
13.en: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

13.zh: 田主的仆人来告诉他说：『主啊，你不是撒好种在田里吗？从哪里来的稗子呢？』
13.en: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’

13.zh: 主人说：『这是仇敌做的。』仆人说：『你要我们去薅出来吗？』
13.en: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’

13.zh: 主人说：『不必，恐怕薅稗子，连麦子也拔出来。
13.en: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

13.zh: 容这两样一齐长，等着收割。当收割的时候，我要对收割的人说，先将稗子薅出来，捆成捆，留着烧；惟有麦子要收在仓里。』」
13.en: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”

13.zh: 他又设个比喻对他们说：「天国好像一粒芥菜种，有人拿去种在田里。
13.en: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,

13.zh: 这原是百种里最小的，等到长起来，却比各样的菜都大，且成了树，天上的飞鸟来宿在它的枝上。」
13.en: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”

13.zh: 他又对他们讲个比喻说：「天国好像面酵，有妇人拿来，藏在三斗面里，直等全团都发起来。」
13.en: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”

13.zh: 这都是耶稣用比喻对众人说的话；若不用比喻，就不对他们说什么。
13.en: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,

13.zh: 这是要应验先知的话，说： 我要开口用比喻， 把创世以来所隐藏的事发明出来。
13.en: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”

13.zh: 当下，耶稣离开众人，进了房子。他的门徒进前来，说：「请把田间稗子的比喻讲给我们听。」
13.en: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”

13.zh: 他回答说：「那撒好种的就是人子；
13.en: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

13.zh: 田地就是世界；好种就是天国之子；稗子就是那恶者之子；
13.en: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

13.zh: 撒稗子的仇敌就是魔鬼；收割的时候就是世界的末了；收割的人就是天使。
13.en: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

13.zh: 将稗子薅出来用火焚烧，世界的末了也要如此。
13.en: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

13.zh: 人子要差遣使者，把一切叫人跌倒的和作恶的，从他国里挑出来，
13.en: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,

13.zh: 丢在火炉里；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。
13.en: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

13.zh: 那时，义人在他们父的国里，要发出光来，像太阳一样。有耳[可听]的，就应当听！」
13.en: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

13.zh: 「天国好像宝贝藏在地里，人遇见了就把它藏起来，欢欢喜喜地去变卖一切所有的，买这块地。
13.en: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

13.zh: 天国又好像买卖人寻找好珠子，
13.en: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

13.zh: 遇见一颗重价的珠子，就去变卖他一切所有的，买了这颗珠子。
13.en: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.

13.zh: 天国又好像网撒在海里，聚拢各样水族，
13.en: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,

13.zh: 网既满了，人就拉上岸来，坐下，拣好的收在器具里，将不好的丢弃了。
13.en: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

13.zh: 世界的末了也要这样。天使要出来，从义人中把恶人分别出来，
13.en: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

13.zh: 丢在火炉里；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。」
13.en: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

13.zh: [耶稣说]：「这一切的话你们都明白了吗？」他们说：「我们明白了。」
13.en: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

13.zh: 他说：「凡文士受教作天国的门徒，就像一个家主从他库里拿出新旧的东西来。」
13.en: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

13.zh: 耶稣说完了这些比喻，就离开那里，
13.en: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

13.zh: 来到自己的家乡，在会堂里教训人，甚至他们都希奇，说：「这人从哪里有这等智慧和异能呢？
13.en: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?

13.zh: 这不是木匠的儿子吗？他母亲不是叫马利亚吗？他弟兄们不是叫雅各、约西、西门、犹大吗？
13.en: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

13.zh: 他妹妹们不是都在我们这里吗？这人从哪里有这一切的事呢？」
13.en: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

13.zh: 他们就厌弃他。耶稣对他们说：「大凡先知，除了本地本家之外，没有不被人尊敬的。」
13.en: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”

13.zh: 耶稣因为他们不信，就在那里不多行异能了。
13.en: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

14.zh: 那时，分封的王希律听见耶稣的名声，
14.en: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

14.zh: 就对臣仆说：「这是施洗的约翰从死里复活，所以这些异能从他里面发出来。」
14.en: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

14.zh: 起先，希律为他兄弟腓力的妻子希罗底的缘故，把约翰拿住，锁在监里。
14.en: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

14.zh: 因为约翰曾对他说：「你娶这妇人是不合理的。」
14.en: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

14.zh: 希律就想要杀他，只是怕百姓，因为他们以约翰为先知。
14.en: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

14.zh: 到了希律的生日，希罗底的女儿在众人面前跳舞，使希律欢喜。
14.en: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

14.zh: 希律就起誓，应许随她所求的给她。
14.en: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

14.zh: 女儿被母亲所使，就说：「请把施洗约翰的头放在盘子里，拿来给我。」
14.en: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

14.zh: 王便忧愁，但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就吩咐给她；
14.en: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

14.zh: 于是打发人去，在监里斩了约翰，
14.en: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

14.zh: 把头放在盘子里，拿来给了女子；女子拿去给她母亲。
14.en: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

14.zh: 约翰的门徒来，把尸首领去埋葬了，就去告诉耶稣。
14.en: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

14.zh: 耶稣听见了，就上船从那里独自退到野地里去。众人听见，就从各城里步行跟随他。
14.en: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

14.zh: 耶稣出来，见有许多的人，就怜悯他们，治好了他们的病人。
14.en: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

14.zh: 天将晚的时候，门徒进前来，说：「这是野地，时候已经过了，请叫众人散开，他们好往村子里去，自己买吃的。」
14.en: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

14.zh: 耶稣说：「不用他们去，你们给他们吃吧！」
14.en: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

14.zh: 门徒说：「我们这里只有五个饼，两条鱼。」
14.en: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

14.zh: 耶稣说：「拿过来给我。」
14.en: He said, “Bring them here to me.”

14.zh: 于是吩咐众人坐在草地上，就拿着这五个饼，两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开饼，递给门徒，门徒又递给众人。
14.en: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

14.zh: 他们都吃，并且吃饱了，把剩下的零碎收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。
14.en: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

14.zh: 吃的人，除了妇女孩子，约有五千。
14.en: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

14.zh: 耶稣随即催门徒上船，先渡到那边去，等他叫众人散开。
14.en: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

14.zh: 散了众人以后，他就独自上山去祷告。到了晚上，只有他一人在那里。
14.en: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

14.zh: 那时船在海中，因风不顺，被浪摇撼。
14.en: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

14.zh: 夜里四更天，耶稣在海面上走，往门徒那里去。
14.en: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

14.zh: 门徒看见他在海面上走，就惊慌了，说：「是个鬼怪！」便害怕，喊叫起来。
14.en: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

14.zh: 耶稣连忙对他们说：「你们放心，是我，不要怕！」
14.en: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

14.zh: 彼得说：「主，如果是你，请叫我从水面上走到你那里去。」
14.en: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

14.zh: 耶稣说：「你来吧。」彼得就从船上下去，在水面上走，要到耶稣那里去；
14.en: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

14.zh: 只因见风甚大，就害怕，将要沉下去，便喊着说：「主啊，救我！」
14.en: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

14.zh: 耶稣赶紧伸手拉住他，说：「你这小信的人哪，为什么疑惑呢？」
14.en: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

14.zh: 他们上了船，风就住了。
14.en: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

14.zh: 在船上的人都拜他，说：「你真是　神的儿子了。」
14.en: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

14.zh: 他们过了[海]，来到革尼撒勒地方。
14.en: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

14.zh: 那里的人一认出是耶稣，就打发人到周围地方去，把所有的病人带到他那里，
14.en: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

14.zh: 只求耶稣准他们摸他的衣裳 子；摸着的人就都好了。
14.en: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

15.zh: 那时，有法利赛人和文士从耶路撒冷来见耶稣，说：
15.en: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

15.zh: 「你的门徒为什么犯古人的遗传呢？因为吃饭的时候，他们不洗手。」
15.en: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”

15.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们为什么因着你们的遗传犯　神的诫命呢？
15.en: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

15.zh: 神说：『当孝敬父母』；又说：『咒骂父母的，必治死他。』
15.en: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

15.zh: 你们倒说：『无论何人对父母说：我所当奉给你的已经作了供献，
15.en: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”

15.zh: 他就可以不孝敬父母。』这就是你们借着遗传，废了　神的诫命。
15.en: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

15.zh: 假冒为善的人哪，以赛亚指着你们说的预言是不错的。他说：
15.en: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

15.zh: 这百姓用嘴唇尊敬我， 心却远离我；
15.en: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

15.zh: 他们将人的吩咐当作道理教导人， 所以拜我也是枉然。」
15.en: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”

15.zh: 耶稣就叫了众人来，对他们说：「你们要听，也要明白。
15.en: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.

15.zh: 入口的不能污秽人，出口的乃能污秽人。」
15.en: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”

15.zh: 当时，门徒进前来对他说：「法利赛人听见这话，不服，你知道吗？」
