15.en: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”

15.zh: 耶稣回答说：「凡栽种的物，若不是我天父栽种的，必要拔出来。
15.en: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.

15.zh: 任凭他们吧！他们是瞎眼领路的；若是瞎子领瞎子，两个人都要掉在坑里。」
15.en: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

15.zh: 彼得对耶稣说：「请将这比喻讲给我们听。」
15.en: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

15.zh: 耶稣说：「你们到如今还不明白吗？
15.en: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

15.zh: 岂不知凡入口的，是运到肚子里，又落在茅厕里吗？
15.en: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?

15.zh: 惟独出口的，是从心里发出来的，这才污秽人。
15.en: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

15.zh: 因为从心里发出来的，有恶念、凶杀、奸淫、苟合、偷盗、妄证、谤 。
15.en: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

15.zh: 这都是污秽人的；至于不洗手吃饭，那却不污秽人。」
15.en: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”

15.zh: 耶稣离开那里，退到泰尔、西顿的境内去。
15.en: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

15.zh: 有一个迦南妇人，从那地方出来，喊着说：「主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我！我女儿被鬼附得甚苦。」
15.en: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

15.zh: 耶稣却一言不答。门徒进前来，求他说：「这妇人在我们后头喊叫，请打发她走吧。」
15.en: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

15.zh: 耶稣说：「我奉差遣不过是到以色列家迷失的羊那里去。」
15.en: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

15.zh: 那妇人来拜他，说：「主啊，帮助我！」
15.en: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

15.zh: 他回答说：「不好拿儿女的饼丢给狗吃。」
15.en: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

15.zh: 妇人说：「主啊，不错；但是狗也吃它主人桌子上掉下来的碎渣儿。」
15.en: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”

15.zh: 耶稣说：「妇人，你的信心是大的！照你所要的，给你成全了吧。」从那时候，她女儿就好了。
15.en: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

15.zh: 耶稣离开那地方，来到靠近加利利的海边，就上山坐下。
15.en: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.

15.zh: 有许多人到他那里，带着瘸子、瞎子、哑巴、有残疾的，和好些别的病人，都放在他脚前；他就治好了他们。
15.en: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

15.zh: 甚至众人都希奇；因为看见哑巴说话，残疾的痊愈，瘸子行走，瞎子看见，他们就归荣耀给以色列的　神。
15.en: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.

15.zh: 耶稣叫门徒来，说：「我怜悯这众人；因为他们同我在这里已经三天，也没有吃的了。我不愿意叫他们饿着回去，恐怕在路上困乏。」
15.en: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

15.zh: 门徒说：「我们在这野地，哪里有这么多的饼叫这许多人吃饱呢？」
15.en: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

15.zh: 耶稣说：「你们有多少饼？」他们说：「有七个，还有几条小鱼。」
15.en: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

15.zh: 他就吩咐众人坐在地上，
15.en: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

15.zh: 拿着这七个饼和几条鱼，祝谢了，擘开，递给门徒；门徒又递给众人。
15.en: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

15.zh: 众人都吃，并且吃饱了，收拾剩下的零碎，装满了七个筐子。
15.en: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

15.zh: 吃的人，除了妇女孩子，共有四千。
15.en: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

15.zh: 耶稣叫众人散去，就上船，来到马加丹的境界。
15.en: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

16.zh: 法利赛人和撒都该人来试探耶稣，请他从天上显个神迹给他们看。
16.en: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

16.zh: 耶稣回答说：「晚上天发红，你们就说：『天必要晴。』
16.en: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’

16.zh: 早晨天发红，又发黑，你们就说：『今日必有风雨。』你们知道分辨天上的气色，倒不能分辨这时候的神迹。
16.en: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!

16.zh: 一个邪恶淫乱的世代求神迹，除了约拿的神迹以外，再没有神迹给他看。」耶稣就离开他们去了。
16.en: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.

16.zh: 门徒渡到那边去，忘了带饼。
16.en: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

16.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们要谨慎，防备法利赛人和撒都该人的酵。」
16.en: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

16.zh: 门徒彼此议论说：「这是因为我们没有带饼吧。」
16.en: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”

16.zh: 耶稣看出来，就说：「你们这小信的人，为什么因为没有饼彼此议论呢？
16.en: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?

16.zh: 你们还不明白吗？不记得那五个饼分给五千人、又收拾了多少篮子[的零碎]吗？
16.en: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,

16.zh: 也不记得那七个饼分给四千人、又收拾了多少筐子[的零碎]吗？
16.en: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

16.zh: 我对你们说：『要防备法利赛人和撒都该人的酵』，这话不是指着饼说的，你们怎么不明白呢？」
16.en: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

16.zh: 门徒这才晓得他说的不是叫他们防备饼的酵，乃是防备法利赛人和撒都该人的教训。
16.en: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

16.zh: 耶稣到了凯撒利亚·腓立比的境内，就问门徒说：「人说我—人子是谁？」
16.en: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”

16.zh: 他们说：「有人说是施洗的约翰；有人说是以利亚；又有人说是耶利米或是先知里的一位。」
16.en: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

16.zh: 耶稣说：「你们说我是谁？」
16.en: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”

16.zh: 西门·彼得回答说：「你是基督，是永生　神的儿子。」
16.en: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

16.zh: 耶稣对他说：「西门·巴·约拿，你是有福的！因为这不是属血肉[的]指示你的，乃是我在天上的父指示的。
16.en: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

16.zh: 我还告诉你，你是彼得，我要把我的教会建造在这磐石上；阴间的权柄不能胜过他。
16.en: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

16.zh: 我要把天国的钥匙给你，凡你在地上所捆绑的，在天上也要捆绑；凡你在地上所释放的，在天上也要释放。」
16.en: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

16.zh: 当下，耶稣嘱咐门徒，不可对人说他是基督。
16.en: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

16.zh: 从此，耶稣才指示门徒，他必须上耶路撒冷去，受长老、祭司长、文士许多的苦，并且被杀，第三日复活。
16.en: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

16.zh: 彼得就拉着他，劝他说：「主啊，万不可如此！这事必不临到你身上。」
16.en: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”

16.zh: 耶稣转过来，对彼得说：「撒但，退我后边去吧！你是绊我脚的；因为你不体贴　神的意思，只体贴人的意思。」
16.en: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”

16.zh: 于是耶稣对门徒说：「若有人要跟从我，就当舍己，背起他的十字架来跟从我。
16.en: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

16.zh: 因为，凡要救自己生命的，必丧掉生命；凡为我丧掉生命的，必得着生命。
16.en: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

16.zh: 人若赚得全世界，赔上自己的生命，有什么益处呢？人还能拿什么换生命呢？
16.en: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

16.zh: 人子要在他父的荣耀里，同着众使者降临；那时候，他要照各人的行为报应各人。
16.en: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will give to everyone according to his deeds.

16.zh: 我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没尝死味以前必看见人子降临在他的国里。」
16.en: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”

17.zh: 过了六天，耶稣带着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰，暗暗地上了高山，
17.en: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

17.zh: 就在他们面前变了形象，脸面明亮如日头，衣裳洁白如光。
17.en: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

17.zh: 忽然，有摩西、以利亚向他们显现，同耶稣说话。
17.en: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

17.zh: 彼得对耶稣说：「主啊，我们在这里真好！你若愿意，我就在这里搭三座棚，一座为你，一座为摩西，一座为以利亚。」
17.en: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

17.zh: 说话之间，忽然有一朵光明的云彩遮盖他们，且有声音从云彩里出来，说：「这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。你们要听他！」
17.en: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

17.zh: 门徒听见，就俯伏在地，极其害怕。
17.en: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

17.zh: 耶稣进前来，摸他们，说：「起来，不要害怕！」
17.en: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”

17.zh: 他们举目不见一人，只见耶稣在那里。
17.en: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

17.zh: 下山的时候，耶稣吩咐他们说：「人子还没有从死里复活，你们不要将所看见的告诉人。」
17.en: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

17.zh: 门徒问耶稣说：「文士为什么说以利亚必须先来？」
17.en: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

17.zh: 耶稣回答说：「以利亚固然先来，并要复兴万事；
17.en: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;

17.zh: 只是我告诉你们，以利亚已经来了，人却不认识他，竟任意待他。人子也将要这样受他们的害。」
17.en: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”

17.zh: 门徒这才明白耶稣所说的是指着施洗的约翰。
17.en: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

17.zh: 耶稣和门徒到了众人那里，有一个人来见耶稣，跪下，
17.en: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

17.zh: 说：「主啊，怜悯我的儿子！他害癫痫的病很苦，屡次跌在火里，屡次跌在水里。
17.en: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

17.zh: 我带他到你门徒那里，他们却不能医治他。」
17.en: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

17.zh: 耶稣说：「嗳！这又不信又悖谬的世代啊，我在你们这里要到几时呢？我忍耐你们要到几时呢？把他带到我这里来吧！」
17.en: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

17.zh: 耶稣斥责那鬼，鬼就出来；从此孩子就痊愈了。
17.en: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

17.zh: 门徒暗暗地到耶稣跟前，说：「我们为什么不能赶出那鬼呢？」
17.en: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

17.zh: 耶稣说：「是因你们的信心小。我实在告诉你们，你们若有信心，像一粒芥菜种，就是对这座山说：『你从这边挪到那边』，它也必挪去；并且你们没有一件不能做的事了。
17.en: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

17.zh: 至于这一类的鬼，若不祷告、禁食，他就不出来。」
17.en: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”

17.zh: 他们还住在加利利的时候，耶稣对门徒说：「人子将要被交在人手里。
17.en: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

17.zh: 他们要杀害他，第三日他要复活。」门徒就大大地忧愁。
17.en: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

17.zh: 到了迦百农，有收丁税的人来见彼得，说：「你们的先生不纳丁税吗？」
17.en: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”

17.zh: 彼得说：「纳。」他进了屋子，耶稣先向他说：「西门，你的意思如何？世上的君王向谁征收关税、丁税？是向自己的儿子呢？是向外人呢？」
17.en: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

17.zh: 彼得说：「是向外人。」耶稣说：「既然如此，儿子就可以免税了。
17.en: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

17.zh: 但恐怕触犯他们，你且往海边去钓鱼，把先钓上来的鱼拿起来，开了它的口，必得一块钱，可以拿去给他们，作你我的税银。」
17.en: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”

18.zh: 当时，门徒进前来，问耶稣说：「天国里谁是最大的？」
18.en: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

18.zh: 耶稣便叫一个小孩子来，使他站在他们当中，
18.en: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them

18.zh: 说：「我实在告诉你们，你们若不回转，变成小孩子的样式，断不得进天国。
18.en: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

18.zh: 所以，凡自己谦卑像这小孩子的，他在天国里就是最大的。
18.en: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

18.zh: 凡为我的名接待一个像这小孩子的，就是接待我。」
18.en: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

18.zh: 「凡使这信我的一个小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在这人的颈项上，沉在深海里。
18.en: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

18.zh: 这世界有祸了，因为将人绊倒；绊倒人的事是免不了的，但那绊倒人的有祸了！
18.en: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

18.zh: 倘若你一只手，或是一只脚，叫你跌倒，就砍下来丢掉。你缺一只手，或是一只脚，进入永生，强如有两手两脚被丢在永火里。
18.en: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

18.zh: 倘若你一只眼叫你跌倒，就把它剜出来丢掉。你只有一只眼进入[永]生，强如有两只眼被丢在地狱的火里。」
18.en: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

18.zh: 「你们要小心，不可轻看这小子里的一个；我告诉你们，他们的使者在天上，常见我天父的面。
18.en: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.
For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.

18.zh: 一个人若有一百只羊，一只走迷了路，你们的意思如何？他岂不撇下这九十九只，往山里去找那只迷路的羊吗？
18.en: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

18.zh: 若是找着了，我实在告诉你们，他为这一只羊欢喜，比为那没有迷路的九十九只欢喜还大呢！
18.en: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

18.zh: 你们在天上的父也是这样，不愿意这小子里失丧一个。」
18.en: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

18.zh: 「倘若你的弟兄得罪你，你就去，趁着只有他和你在一处的时候，指出他的错来。他若听你，你便得了你的弟兄；
18.en: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

18.zh: 他若不听，你就另外带一两个人同去，要凭两三个人的口作见证，句句都可定准。
18.en: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

18.zh: 若是不听他们，就告诉教会；若是不听教会，就看他像外邦人和税吏一样。
18.en: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.

18.zh: 「我实在告诉你们，凡你们在地上所捆绑的，在天上也要捆绑；凡你们在地上所释放的，在天上也要释放。
18.en: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

18.zh: 我又告诉你们，若是你们中间有两个人在地上同心合意地求什么事，我在天上的父必为他们成全。
18.en: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

18.zh: 因为无论在哪里，有两三个人奉我的名聚会，那里就有我在他们中间。」
18.en: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

18.zh: 那时，彼得进前来，对耶稣说：「主啊，我弟兄得罪我，我当饶恕他几次呢？到七次可以吗？」
18.en: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

18.zh: 耶稣说：「我对你说，不是到七次，乃是到七十个七次。
18.en: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

18.zh: 天国好像一个王要和他仆人算帐。
18.en: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

18.zh: 才算的时候，有人带了一个欠一千万银子的来。
18.en: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

18.zh: 因为他没有什么偿还之物，主人吩咐把他和他妻子儿女，并一切所有的都卖了偿还。
18.en: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

18.zh: 那仆人就俯伏拜他，说：『主啊，宽容我，将来我都要还清。』
18.en: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’

18.zh: 那仆人的主人就动了慈心，把他释放了，并且免了他的债。
18.en: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.

18.zh: 「那仆人出来，遇见他的一个同伴欠他十两银子，便揪着他，掐住他的喉咙，说：『你把所欠的还我！』
18.en: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

18.zh: 他的同伴就俯伏央求他，说：『宽容我吧，将来我必还清。』
18.en: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

18.zh: 他不肯，竟去把他下在监里，等他还了所欠的债。
18.en: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.

18.zh: 众同伴看见他所做的事就甚忧愁，去把这事都告诉了主人。
18.en: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

18.zh: 于是主人叫了他来，对他说：『你这恶奴才！你央求我，我就把你所欠的都免了，
18.en: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

18.zh: 你不应当怜恤你的同伴，像我怜恤你吗？』
18.en: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

18.zh: 主人就大怒，把他交给掌刑的，等他还清了所欠的债。
18.en: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

18.zh: 你们各人若不从心里饶恕你的弟兄，我天父也要这样待你们了。」
18.en: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”

19.zh: 耶稣说完了这些话，就离开加利利，来到犹太的境界约旦河外。
19.en: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

19.zh: 有许多人跟着他，他就在那里把他们[的病人]治好了。
19.en: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

19.zh: 有法利赛人来试探耶稣，说：「人无论什么缘故都可以休妻吗？」
19.en: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

19.zh: 耶稣回答说：「那起初造人的，是造男造女，
19.en: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

19.zh: 并且说：『因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。』[这经]你们没有念过吗？
19.en: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?

19.zh: 既然如此，夫妻不再是两个人，乃是一体的了。所以，　神配合的，人不可分开。」
19.en: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

19.zh: 法利赛人说：「这样，摩西为什么吩咐给妻子休书，就可以休她呢？」
19.en: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”

19.zh: 耶稣说：「摩西因为你们的心硬，所以许你们休妻，但起初并不是这样。
19.en: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

19.zh: 我告诉你们，凡休妻另娶的，若不是为淫乱的缘故，就是犯奸淫了；有人娶那被休的妇人，也是犯奸淫了。」
19.en: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”

19.zh: 门徒对耶稣说：「人和妻子既是这样，倒不如不娶。」
19.en: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”

19.zh: 耶稣说：「这话不是人都能领受的，惟独赐给谁，谁才能领受。
19.en: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

19.zh: 因为有生来是阉人，也有被人阉的，并有为天国的缘故自阉的。这话谁能领受就可以领受。」
19.en: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

19.zh: 那时，有人带着小孩子来见耶稣，要耶稣给他们按手祷告，门徒就责备那些人。
19.en: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

19.zh: 耶稣说：「让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们；因为在天国的，正是这样的人。」
19.en: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

19.zh: 耶稣给他们按手，就离开那地方去了。
19.en: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

19.zh: 有一个人来见耶稣，说：「夫子，我该做什么善事才能得永生？」
19.en: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”

19.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你为什么以善事问我呢？只有一位是善的。你若要进入[永]生，就当遵守诫命。」
19.en: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

19.zh: 他说：「什么诫命？」耶稣说：「就是不可杀人；不可奸淫；不可偷盗；不可作假见证；
19.en: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’

19.zh: 当孝敬父母；又当爱人如己。」
19.en: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”

19.zh: 那少年人说：「这一切我都遵守了，还缺少什么呢？」
19.en: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”

19.zh: 耶稣说：「你若愿意作完全人，可去变卖你所有的，分给穷人，就必有财宝在天上；你还要来跟从我。」
19.en: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”

19.zh: 那少年人听见这话，就忧忧愁愁地走了，因为他的产业很多。
19.en: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

19.zh: 耶稣对门徒说：「我实在告诉你们，财主进天国是难的。
19.en: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

19.zh: 我又告诉你们，骆驼穿过针的眼，比财主进　神的国还容易呢！」
19.en: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

19.zh: 门徒听见这话，就希奇得很，说：「这样谁能得救呢？」
19.en: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”

19.zh: 耶稣看着他们，说：「在人这是不能的，在　神凡事都能。」
19.en: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

19.zh: 彼得就对他说：「看哪，我们已经撇下所有的跟从你，将来我们要得什么呢？」
19.en: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have?”

19.zh: 耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，你们这跟从我的人，到复兴的时候，人子坐在他荣耀的宝座上，你们也要坐在十二个宝座上，审判以色列十二个支派。
19.en: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

19.zh: 凡为我的名撇下房屋，或是弟兄、姊妹、父亲、母亲、 儿女、田地的，必要得着百倍，并且承受永生。
19.en: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

19.zh: 然而，有许多在前的，将要在后；在后的，将要在前。」
19.en: But many will be last who are first, and first who are last.

20.zh: 「因为天国好像家主清早去雇人进他的葡萄园做工，
20.en: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

20.zh: 和工人讲定一天一钱银子，就打发他们进葡萄园去。
20.en: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

20.zh: 约在巳初出去，看见市上还有闲站的人，
20.en: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

20.zh: 就对他们说：『你们也进葡萄园去，所当给的，我必给你们。』他们也进去了。
20.en: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.

20.zh: 约在午正和申初又出去，也是这样行。
20.en: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.

20.zh: 约在酉初出去，看见还有人站在那里，就问他们说：『你们为什么整天在这里闲站呢？』
20.en: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

20.zh: 他们说：『因为没有人雇我们。』他说：『你们也进葡萄园去。』
20.en: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

20.zh: 到了晚上，园主对管事的说：『叫工人都来，给他们工钱，从后来的起，到先来的为止。
20.en: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

20.zh: 约在酉初雇的人来了，各人得了一钱银子。
20.en: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

20.zh: 及至那先雇的来了，他们以为必要多得；谁知也是各得一钱。
20.en: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

20.zh: 他们得了，就埋怨家主说：
20.en: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

20.zh: 『我们整天劳苦受热，那后来的只做了一小时，你竟叫他们和我们一样吗？』
20.en: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

20.zh: 家主回答其中的一人说：『朋友，我不亏负你，你与我讲定的不是一钱银子吗？
20.en: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?

20.zh: 拿你的走吧！我给那后来的和给你一样，这是我愿意的。
20.en: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

20.zh: 我的东西难道不可随我的意思用吗？因为我作好人，你就红了眼吗？』
20.en: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

20.zh: 这样，那在后的，将要在前；在前的，将要在后了。」
20.en: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

20.zh: 耶稣上耶路撒冷去的时候，在路上把十二个门徒带到一边，对他们说：
20.en: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

20.zh: 「看哪，我们上耶路撒冷去，人子要被交给祭司长和文士。他们要定他死罪，
20.en: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

20.zh: 又交给外邦人，将他戏弄，鞭打，钉在十字架上；第三日他要复活。」
20.en: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

20.zh: 那时，西庇太儿子的母亲同她两个儿子上前来拜耶稣，求他一件事。
20.en: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

20.zh: 耶稣说：「你要什么呢？」她说：「愿你叫我这两个儿子在你国里，一个坐在你右边，一个坐在你左边。」
20.en: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

20.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们不知道所求的是什么；我将要喝的杯，你们能喝吗？」他们说：「我们能。」
20.en: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”

20.zh: 耶稣说：「我所喝的杯，你们必要喝；只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以赐的，乃是我父为谁预备的，就赐给谁。」
20.en: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

20.zh: 那十个门徒听见，就恼怒他们弟兄二人。
20.en: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

20.zh: 耶稣叫了他们来，说：「你们知道外邦人有君王为主治理他们，有大臣操权管束他们。
20.en: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

20.zh: 只是在你们中间，不可这样；你们中间谁愿为大，就必作你们的用人；
20.en: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

20.zh: 谁愿为首，就必作你们的仆人。
20.en: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

20.zh: 正如人子来，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，并且要舍命，作多人的赎价。」
20.en: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

20.zh: 他们出耶利哥的时候，有极多的人跟随他。
20.en: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

20.zh: 有两个瞎子坐在路旁，听说是耶稣经过，就喊着说：「主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！」
20.en: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

20.zh: 众人责备他们，不许他们作声；他们却越发喊着说：「主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！」
20.en: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

20.zh: 耶稣就站住，叫他们来，说：「要我为你们做什么？」
20.en: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”

20.zh: 他们说：「主啊，要我们的眼睛能看见！」
20.en: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

20.zh: 耶稣就动了慈心，把他们的眼睛一摸，他们立刻看见，就跟从了耶稣。
20.en: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

21.zh: 耶稣和门徒将近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其，在橄榄山那里。
21.en: When they came near to Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

21.zh: 耶稣就打发两个门徒，对他们说：「你们往对面村子里去，必看见一匹驴拴在那里，还有驴驹同在一处；你们解开，牵到我这里来。
21.en: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.

21.zh: 若有人对你们说什么，你们就说：『主要用它。』那人必立时让你们牵来。
21.en: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”

21.zh: 这事成就是要应验先知的话，说：
21.en: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

21.zh: 要对锡安的居民说： 看哪，你的王来到你这里， 是温柔的，又骑着驴， 就是骑着驴驹子。」
21.en: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”

21.zh: 门徒就照耶稣所吩咐的去行，
21.en: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,

21.zh: 牵了驴和驴驹来，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶稣就骑上。
21.en: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.

21.zh: 众人多半把衣服铺在路上；还有人砍下树枝来铺在路上。
21.en: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

21.zh: 前行后随的众人喊着说： 和散那归于大卫的子孙！ 奉主名来的是应当称颂的！ 高高在上和散那！
21.en: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

21.zh: 耶稣既进了耶路撒冷，合城都惊动了，说：「这是谁？」
21.en: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”

21.zh: 众人说：「这是加利利拿撒勒的先知耶稣。」
21.en: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”

21.zh: 耶稣进了　神的殿，赶出殿里一切做买卖的人，推倒兑换银钱之人的桌子，和卖鸽子之人的凳子，
21.en: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

21.zh: 对他们说：「[经上]记着说： 我的殿必称为祷告的殿， 你们倒使它成为贼窝了。」
21.en: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”

21.zh: 在殿里有瞎子、瘸子到耶稣跟前，他就治好了他们。
21.en: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

21.zh: 祭司长和文士看见耶稣所行的奇事，又见小孩子在殿里喊着说：「和散那归于大卫的子孙！」就甚恼怒，
21.en: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,

21.zh: 对他说：「这些人所说的，你听见了吗？」耶稣说：「是的。[经上]说『你从婴孩和吃奶的口中完全了赞美』的话，你们没有念过吗？」
21.en: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have perfected praise’?”

21.zh: 于是离开他们，出城到伯大尼去，在那里住宿。
21.en: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

21.zh: 早晨回城的时候，他饿了，
21.en: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

21.zh: 看见路旁有一棵无花果树，就走到跟前，在树上找不着什么，不过有叶子，就对树说：「从今以后，你永不结果子。」那无花果树就立刻枯干了。
21.en: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.

21.zh: 门徒看见了，便希奇说：「无花果树怎么立刻枯干了呢？」
21.en: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”

21.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我实在告诉你们，你们若有信心，不疑惑，不但能行无花果树上所行的事，就是对这座山说：『你挪开此地，投在海里！』也必成就。
21.en: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

21.zh: 你们祷告，无论求什么，只要信，就必得着。」
21.en: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”

21.zh: 耶稣进了殿，正教训人的时候，祭司长和民间的长老来问他说：「你仗着什么权柄做这些事？给你这权柄的是谁呢？」
21.en: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”

21.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我也要问你们一句话，你们若告诉我，我就告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。
21.en: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

21.zh: 约翰的洗礼是从哪里来的？是从天上来的？是从人间来的呢？」他们彼此商议说：「我们若说『从天上来』，他必对我们说：『这样，你们为什么不信他呢？』
21.en: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

21.zh: 若说『从人间来』，我们又怕百姓，因为他们都以约翰为先知。」
21.en: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”

21.zh: 于是回答耶稣说：「我们不知道。」耶稣说：「我也不告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。」
21.en: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

21.zh: 又说：「一个人有两个儿子。他来对大儿子说：『我儿，你今天到葡萄园里去做工。』
21.en: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

21.zh: 他回答说：『我不去』，以后自己懊悔，就去了。
21.en: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

21.zh: 又来对小儿子也是这样说。他回答说：『父啊，我去』，他却不去。
21.en: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

21.zh: 你们想，这两个儿子是哪一个遵行父命呢？」他们说：「大儿子。」耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，税吏和娼妓倒比你们先进　神的国。
21.en: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.

21.zh: 因为约翰遵着义路到你们这里来，你们却不信他；税吏和娼妓倒信他。你们看见了，后来还是不懊悔去信他。」
21.en: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

21.zh: 「你们再听一个比喻：有个家主栽了一个葡萄园，周围圈上篱笆，里面挖了一个压酒池，盖了一座楼，租给园户，就往外国去了。
21.en: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

21.zh: 收果子的时候近了，就打发仆人到园户那里去收果子。
21.en: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.

21.zh: 园户拿住仆人，打了一个，杀了一个，用石头打死一个。
21.en: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

21.zh: 主人又打发别的仆人去，比先前更多；园户还是照样待他们。
21.en: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.

21.zh: 后来打发他的儿子到他们那里去，[意思]说：『他们必尊敬我的儿子。』
21.en: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

21.zh: 不料，园户看见他儿子，就彼此说：『这是承受产业的。来吧，我们杀他，占他的产业！』
21.en: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’

21.zh: 他们就拿住他，推出葡萄园外，杀了。
21.en: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.

21.zh: 园主来的时候要怎样处治这些园户呢？」
21.en: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”

21.zh: 他们说：「要下毒手除灭那些恶人，将葡萄园另租给那按着时候交果子的园户。」
21.en: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”

21.zh: 耶稣说：「[经上写着]： 匠人所弃的石头 已作了房角的头块石头。 这是主所做的， 在我们眼中看为希奇。 这经你们没有念过吗？
21.en: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?

21.zh: 所以我告诉你们，　神的国必从你们夺去，赐给那能结果子的百姓。
21.en: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.

21.zh: 谁掉在这石头上，必要跌碎；这石头掉在谁的身上，就要把谁砸得稀烂。」
21.en: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”

21.zh: 祭司长和法利赛人听见他的比喻，就看出他是指着他们说的。
21.en: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

21.zh: 他们想要捉拿他，只是怕众人，因为众人以他为先知。
21.en: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

22.zh: 耶稣又用比喻对他们说：
22.en: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,

22.zh: 「天国好比一个王为他儿子摆设娶亲的筵席，
22.en: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,

22.zh: 就打发仆人去，请那些被召的人来赴席，他们却不肯来。
22.en: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.

22.zh: 王又打发别的仆人，说：『你们告诉那被召的人，我的筵席已经预备好了，牛和肥畜已经宰了，各样都齐备，请你们来赴席。』
22.en: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’

22.zh: 那些人不理就走了；一个到自己田里去；一个做买卖去；
22.en: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;

22.zh: 其余的拿住仆人，凌辱他们，把他们杀了。
22.en: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.

22.zh: 王就大怒，发兵除灭那些凶手，烧毁他们的城。
22.en: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

22.zh: 于是对仆人说：『喜筵已经齐备，只是所召的人不配。
22.en: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

22.zh: 所以你们要往岔路口上去，凡遇见的，都召来赴席。』
22.en: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’

22.zh: 那些仆人就出去，到大路上，凡遇见的，不论善恶都召聚了来，筵席上就坐满了客。
22.en: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.

22.zh: 王进来观看宾客，见那里有一个没有穿礼服的，
22.en: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

22.zh: 就对他说：『朋友，你到这里来怎么不穿礼服呢？』那人无言可答。
22.en: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.

22.zh: 于是王对使唤的人说：『捆起他的手脚来，把他丢在外边的黑暗里；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。』
22.en: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

22.zh: 因为被召的人多，选上的人少。」
22.en: For many are called, but few chosen.”

22.zh: 当时，法利赛人出去商议，怎样就着耶稣的话陷害他，
22.en: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

22.zh: 就打发他们的门徒同希律党的人去见耶稣，说：「夫子，我们知道你是诚实人，并且诚诚实实传　神的道，什么人你都不徇情面，因为你不看人的外貌。
22.en: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.

22.zh: 请告诉我们，你的意见如何？纳税给凯撒可以不可以？」
22.en: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

22.zh: 耶稣看出他们的恶意，就说：「假冒为善的人哪，为什么试探我？
22.en: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

22.zh: 拿一个上税的钱给我看！」他们就拿一个银钱来给他。
22.en: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.

22.zh: 耶稣说：「这像和这号是谁的？」
22.en: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”

22.zh: 他们说：「是凯撒的。」耶稣说：「这样，凯撒的物当归给凯撒；　神的物当归给　神。」
22.en: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

22.zh: 他们听见就希奇，离开他走了。
22.en: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.

22.zh: 撒都该人常说没有复活的事。那天，他们来问耶稣说：
22.en: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

22.zh: 「夫子，摩西说：『人若死了，没有孩子，他兄弟当娶他的妻，为哥哥生子立后。』
22.en: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

22.zh: 从前，在我们这里有弟兄七人，第一个娶了妻，死了，没有孩子，撇下妻子给兄弟。
22.en: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

22.zh: 第二、第三，直到第七个，都是如此。
22.en: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

22.zh: 末后，妇人也死了。
22.en: After them all, the woman died.

22.zh: 这样，当复活的时候，她是七个人中哪一个的妻子呢？因为他们都娶过她。」
22.en: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

22.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们错了；因为不明白圣经，也不晓得　神的大能。
22.en: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

22.zh: 当复活的时候，人也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一样。
22.en: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

22.zh: 论到死人复活，　神[在经上]向你们所说的，你们没有念过吗？
22.en: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

22.zh: 他说：『我是亚伯拉罕的　神，以撒的　神，雅各的　神。』　神不是死人的　神，乃是活人的　神。」
22.en: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

22.zh: 众人听见这话，就希奇他的教训。
22.en: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

22.zh: 法利赛人听见耶稣堵住了撒都该人的口，他们就聚集。
22.en: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

22.zh: 内中有一个人是律法师，要试探耶稣，就问他说：
22.en: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

22.zh: 「夫子，律法上的诫命，哪一条是最大的呢？」
22.en: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”

22.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你要尽心、尽性、尽意爱主—你的　神。
22.en: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

22.zh: 这是诫命中的第一，且是最大的。
22.en: This is the first and great commandment.

22.zh: 其次也相仿，就是要爱人如己。
22.en: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

22.zh: 这两条诫命是律法和先知一切[道理]的总纲。」
22.en: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

22.zh: 法利赛人聚集的时候，耶稣问他们说：
22.en: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

22.zh: 「论到基督，你们的意见如何？他是谁的子孙呢？」他们回答说：「是大卫的子孙。」
22.en: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”

22.zh: 耶稣说：「这样，大卫被圣灵感动，怎么还称他为主，说：
22.en: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

22.zh: 主对我主说： 你坐在我的右边， 等我把你仇敌放在你的脚下。
22.en: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?

22.zh: 大卫既称他为主，他怎么又是大卫的子孙呢？」
22.en: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”

22.zh: 他们没有一个人能回答一言。从那日以后，也没有人敢再问他什么。
22.en: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

23.zh: 那时，耶稣对众人和门徒讲论，
23.en: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

23.zh: 说：「文士和法利赛人坐在摩西的位上，
23.en: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.

23.zh: 凡他们所吩咐你们的，你们都要谨守遵行。但不要效法他们的行为；因为他们能说，不能行。
23.en: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.

23.zh: 他们把难担的重担捆起来，搁在人的肩上，但自己一个指头也不肯动。
23.en: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

23.zh: 他们一切所做的事都是要叫人看见，所以将佩戴的经文做宽了，[衣裳的] 子做长了，
23.en: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,

23.zh: 喜爱筵席上的首座，会堂里的高位，
23.en: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

23.zh: 又喜爱人在街市上问他安，称呼他拉比。
23.en: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.

23.zh: 但你们不要受拉比的称呼，因为只有一位是你们的夫子；你们都是弟兄。
23.en: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

23.zh: 也不要称呼地上的人为父，因为只有一位是你们的父，就是在天上的父。
23.en: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

23.zh: 也不要受师尊的称呼，因为只有一位是你们的师尊，就是基督。
23.en: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

23.zh: 你们中间谁为大，谁就要作你们的用人。
23.en: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

23.zh: 凡自高的，必降为卑；自卑的，必升为高。
23.en: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

23.zh: 「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们正当人前，把天国[的门]关了，自己不进去，正要进去的人，你们也不容他们进去。
23.en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.
“But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

23.zh: 「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们走遍洋海陆地，勾引一个人入教，既入了教，却使他作地狱之子，比你们还加倍。
23.en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

23.zh: 「你们这瞎眼领路的有祸了！你们说：『凡指着殿起誓的，这算不得什么；只是凡指着殿中金子起誓的，他就该谨守。』
23.en: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

23.zh: 你们这无知瞎眼的人哪，什么是大的？是金子呢？还是叫金子成圣的殿呢？
23.en: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

23.zh: 你们又说：『凡指着坛起誓的，这算不得什么；只是凡指着坛上礼物起誓的，他就该谨守。』
23.en: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’

23.zh: 你们这瞎眼的人哪，什么是大的？是礼物呢？还是叫礼物成圣的坛呢？
23.en: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

23.zh: 所以，人指着坛起誓，就是指着坛和坛上一切所有的起誓；
23.en: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.

23.zh: 人指着殿起誓，就是指着殿和那住在殿里的起誓；
23.en: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.

23.zh: 人指着天起誓，就是指着　神的宝座和那坐在上面的起誓。
23.en: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.

23.zh: 「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们将薄荷、茴香、芹菜献上十分之一，那律法上更重的事，就是公义、怜悯、信实，反倒不行了。这[更重的]是你们当行的；那也是不可不行的。
23.en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

23.zh: 你们这瞎眼领路的，蠓虫你们就滤出来，骆驼你们倒吞下去。
23.en: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

23.zh: 「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们洗净杯盘的外面，里面却盛满了勒索和放荡。
23.en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

23.zh: 你这瞎眼的法利赛人，先洗净杯盘的里面，好叫外面也干净了。
23.en: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

23.zh: 「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们好像粉饰的坟墓，外面好看，里面却装满了死人的骨头和一切的污秽。
23.en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

23.zh: 你们也是如此，在人前，外面显出公义来，里面却装满了假善和不法的事。
23.en: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

23.zh: 「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们建造先知的坟，修饰义人的墓，说：
23.en: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

23.zh: 『若是我们在我们祖宗的时候，必不和他们同流先知的血。』
23.en: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

23.zh: 这就是你们自己证明是杀害先知者的子孙了。
23.en: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

23.zh: 你们去充满你们祖宗的恶贯吧！
23.en: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

23.zh: 你们这些蛇类、毒蛇之种啊，怎能逃脱地狱的刑罚呢？
23.en: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

23.zh: 所以我差遣先知和智慧人并文士到你们这里来，有的你们要杀害，要钉十字架；有的你们要在会堂里鞭打，从这城追逼到那城，
23.en: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

23.zh: 叫世上所流义人的血都归到你们身上，从义人亚伯的血起，直到你们在殿和坛中间所杀的巴拉加的儿子撒迦利亚的血为止。
23.en: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

23.zh: 我实在告诉你们，这一切的罪都要归到这世代了。」
23.en: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

23.zh: 「耶路撒冷啊，耶路撒冷啊，你常杀害先知，又用石头打死那奉差遣到你这里来的人。我多次愿意聚集你的儿女，好像母鸡把小鸡聚集在翅膀底下，只是你们不愿意。
23.en: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

23.zh: 看哪，你们的家成为荒场留给你们。
23.en: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

23.zh: 我告诉你们，从今以后，你们不得再见我，直等到你们说：『奉主名来的是应当称颂的。』」
23.en: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

24.zh: 耶稣出了[圣]殿，正走的时候，门徒进前来，把殿宇指给他看。
24.en: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

24.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们不是看见这殿宇吗？我实在告诉你们，将来在这里没有一块石头留在石头上，不被拆毁了。」
24.en: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”

24.zh: 耶稣在橄榄山上坐着，门徒暗暗地来说：「请告诉我们，什么时候有这些事？你降临和世界的末了有什么预兆呢？」
24.en: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

24.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们要谨慎，免得有人迷惑你们。
24.en: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

24.zh: 因为将来有好些人冒我的名来，说：『我是基督』，并且要迷惑许多人。
24.en: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

24.zh: 你们也要听见打仗和打仗的风声，总不要惊慌；因为[这些事]是必须有的，只是末期还没有到。
24.en: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

24.zh: 民要攻打民，国要攻打国；多处必有饥荒、地震。
24.en: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

24.zh: 这都是灾难的起头。
24.en: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

24.zh: 那时，人要把你们陷在患难里，也要杀害你们；你们又要为我的名被万民恨恶。
24.en: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.

24.zh: 那时，必有许多人跌倒，也要彼此陷害，彼此恨恶；
24.en: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

24.zh: 且有好些假先知起来，迷惑多人。
24.en: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.

24.zh: 只因不法的事增多，许多人的爱心才渐渐冷淡了。
24.en: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

24.zh: 惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。
24.en: But he who endures to the end will be saved.

24.zh: 这天国的福音要传遍天下，对万民作见证，然后末期才来到。」
24.en: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

24.zh: 「你们看见先知但以理所说的『那行毁坏可憎的』站在圣地（读[这经]的人须要会意）。
24.en: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

24.zh: 那时，在犹太的，应当逃到山上；
24.en: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

24.zh: 在房上的，不要下来拿家里的东西；
24.en: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

24.zh: 在田里的，也不要回去取衣裳。
24.en: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

24.zh: 当那些日子，怀孕的和奶孩子的有祸了。
24.en: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

24.zh: 你们应当祈求，叫你们逃走的时候，不遇见冬天或是安息日。
24.en: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,

24.zh: 因为那时必有大灾难，从世界的起头直到如今，没有这样的灾难，后来也必没有。
24.en: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

24.zh: 若不减少那日子，凡有血气的总没有一个得救的；只是为选民，那日子必减少了。
24.en: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

24.zh: 那时，若有人对你们说：『基督在这里』，或说：『基督在那里』，你们不要信！
24.en: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.

24.zh: 因为假基督、假先知将要起来，显大神迹、大奇事，倘若能行，连选民也就迷惑了。
24.en: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

24.zh: 看哪，我预先告诉你们了。
24.en: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.

24.zh: 若有人对你们说：『看哪，基督在旷野里』，你们不要出去！[或说]：『看哪，基督在内屋中』，你们不要信！
24.en: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

24.zh: 闪电从东边发出，直照到西边。人子降临也要这样。
24.en: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

24.zh: 尸首在哪里，鹰也必聚在那里。」
24.en: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.

24.zh: 「那些日子的灾难一过去， 日头就变黑了， 月亮也不放光， 众星要从天上坠落， 天势都要震动。
24.en: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;

24.zh: 那时，人子的兆头要显在天上，地上的万族都要哀哭。他们要看见人子，有能力，有大荣耀，驾着天上的云降临。
24.en: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

24.zh: 他要差遣使者，用号筒的大声，将他的选民，从四方，从天这边到天那边，都招聚了来。」
24.en: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

24.zh: 「你们可以从无花果树学个比方：当树枝发嫩长叶的时候，你们就知道夏天近了。
24.en: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

24.zh: 这样，你们看见这一切的事，也该知道人子近了，正在门口了。
24.en: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.

24.zh: 我实在告诉你们，这世代还没有过去，这些事都要成就。
24.en: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.

24.zh: 天地要废去，我的话却不能废去。」
24.en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

24.zh: 「但那日子，那时辰，没有人知道，连天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟独父知道。
24.en: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

24.zh: 挪亚的日子怎样，人子降临也要怎样。
24.en: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

24.zh: 当洪水以前的日子，人照常吃喝嫁娶，直到挪亚进方舟的那日；
24.en: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,

24.zh: 不知不觉洪水来了，把他们全都冲去。人子降临也要这样。
24.en: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

24.zh: 那时，两个人在田里，取去一个，撇下一个。
24.en: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.

24.zh: 两个女人推磨，取去一个，撇下一个。
24.en: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

24.zh: 所以，你们要警醒，因为不知道你们的主是哪一天来到。
24.en: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

24.zh: 家主若知道几更天有贼来，就必警醒，不容人挖透房屋；这是你们所知道的。
24.en: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

24.zh: 所以，你们也要预备，因为你们想不到的时候，人子就来了。」
24.en: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

24.zh: 「谁是忠心有见识的仆人，为主人所派，管理家里的人，按时分粮给他们呢？
24.en: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

24.zh: 主人来到，看见他这样行，那仆人就有福了。
24.en: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

24.zh: 我实在告诉你们，主人要派他管理一切所有的。
24.en: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

24.zh: 倘若那恶仆心里说：『我的主人必来得迟』，
24.en: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

24.zh: 就动手打他的同伴，又和酒醉的人一同吃喝。
24.en: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

24.zh: 在想不到的日子，不知道的时辰，那仆人的主人要来，
24.en: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

24.zh: 重重地处治他，定他和假冒为善的人同罪；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。」
24.en: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

25.zh: 「那时，天国好比十个童女拿着灯出去迎接新郎。
25.en: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

25.zh: 其中有五个是愚拙的，五个是聪明的。
25.en: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

25.zh: 愚拙的拿着灯，却不预备油；
25.en: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,

25.zh: 聪明的拿着灯，又预备油在器皿里。
25.en: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

25.zh: 新郎迟延的时候，她们都打盹，睡着了。
25.en: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.

25.zh: 半夜有人喊着说：『新郎来了，你们出来迎接他！』
25.en: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’

25.zh: 那些童女就都起来收拾灯。
25.en: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

25.zh: 愚拙的对聪明的说：『请分点油给我们，因为我们的灯要灭了。』
25.en: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’

25.zh: 聪明的回答说：『恐怕不够你我用的；不如你们自己到卖油的那里去买吧。』
25.en: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’

25.zh: 她们去买的时候，新郎到了。那预备好了的，同他进去坐席，门就关了。
25.en: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

25.zh: 其余的童女随后也来了，说：『主啊，主啊，给我们开门！』
25.en: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’

25.zh: 他却回答说：『我实在告诉你们，我不认识你们。』
25.en: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’

25.zh: 所以，你们要警醒；因为那日子，那时辰，你们不知道。」
25.en: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.

25.zh: 「[天国]又好比一个人要往外国去，就叫了仆人来，把他的家业交给他们，
25.en: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.

25.zh: 按着各人的才干给他们银子：一个给了五千，一个给了二千，一个给了一千，就往外国去了。
25.en: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

25.zh: 那领五千的随即拿去做买卖，另外赚了五千。
25.en: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

25.zh: 那领二千的也照样另赚了二千。
25.en: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

25.zh: 但那领一千的去掘开地，把主人的银子埋藏了。
25.en: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.

25.zh: 过了许久，那些仆人的主人来了，和他们算帐。
25.en: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.

25.zh: 那领五千银子的又带着那另外的五千来，说：『主啊，你交给我五千银子。请看，我又赚了五千。』
25.en: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’

25.zh: 主人说：『好，你这又良善又忠心的仆人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把许多事派你管理；可以进来享受你主人的快乐。』
25.en: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

25.zh: 那领二千的也来，说：『主啊，你交给我二千银子。请看，我又赚了二千。』
25.en: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’

25.zh: 主人说：『好，你这又良善又忠心的仆人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把许多事派你管理；可以进来享受你主人的快乐。』
25.en: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

25.zh: 那领一千的也来，说：『主啊，我知道你是忍心的人，没有种的地方要收割，没有散的地方要聚敛，
25.en: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.

25.zh: 我就害怕，去把你的一千银子埋藏在地里。请看，你的原银子在这里。』
25.en: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

25.zh: 主人回答说：『你这又恶又懒的仆人，你既知道我没有种的地方要收割，没有散的地方要聚敛，
25.en: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.

25.zh: 就当把我的银子放给兑换银钱的人，到我来的时候，可以连本带利收回。
25.en: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

25.zh: 夺过他这一千来，给那有一万的。
25.en: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.

25.zh: 因为凡有的，还要加给他，叫他有余；没有的，连他所有的也要夺过来。
25.en: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

25.zh: 把这无用的仆人丢在外面黑暗里；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。』」
25.en: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

25.zh: 「当人子在他荣耀里、同着众天使降临的时候，要坐在他荣耀的宝座上。
25.en: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

25.zh: 万民都要聚集在他面前。他要把他们分别出来，好像牧羊的分别绵羊山羊一般，
25.en: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

25.zh: 把绵羊安置在右边，山羊在左边。
25.en: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

25.zh: 于是王要向那右边的说：『你们这蒙我父赐福的，可来承受那创世以来为你们所预备的国；
25.en: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;

25.zh: 因为我饿了，你们给我吃，渴了，你们给我喝；我作客旅，你们留我住；
25.en: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.

25.zh: 我赤身露体，你们给我穿；我病了，你们看顾我；我在监里，你们来看我。』
25.en: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’

25.zh: 义人就回答说：『主啊，我们什么时候见你饿了，给你吃，渴了，给你喝？
25.en: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?

25.zh: 什么时候见你作客旅，留你住，或是赤身露体，给你穿？
25.en: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?

25.zh: 又什么时候见你病了，或是在监里，来看你呢？』
25.en: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’

25.zh: 王要回答说：『我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。』
25.en: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’

25.zh: 王又要向那左边的说：『你们这被咒诅的人，离开我！进入那为魔鬼和他的使者所预备的永火里去！
25.en: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;

25.zh: 因为我饿了，你们不给我吃，渴了，你们不给我喝；
25.en: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;

25.zh: 我作客旅，你们不留我住；我赤身露体，你们不给我穿；我病了，我在监里，你们不来看顾我。』
25.en: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’

25.zh: 他们也要回答说：『主啊，我们什么时候见你饿了，或渴了，或作客旅，或赤身露体，或病了，或在监里，不伺候你呢？』
25.en: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’

25.zh: 王要回答说：『我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既不做在我这[弟兄]中一个最小的身上，就是不做在我身上了。』
25.en: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’

25.zh: 这些人要往永刑里去；那些义人要往永生里去。」
25.en: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

26.zh: 耶稣说完了这一切的话，就对门徒说：
26.en: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,

26.zh: 「你们知道，过两天是逾越节，人子将要被交给人，钉在十字架上。」
26.en: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”

26.zh: 那时，祭司长和民间的长老聚集在大祭司称为该亚法的院里。
26.en: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

26.zh: 大家商议要用诡计拿住耶稣，杀他，
26.en: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.

26.zh: 只是说：「当节的日子不可，恐怕民间生乱。」
26.en: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”

26.zh: 耶稣在伯大尼长大麻风的西门家里，
26.en: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

26.zh: 有一个女人拿着一玉瓶极贵的香膏来，趁耶稣坐席的时候，浇在他的头上。
26.en: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

26.zh: 门徒看见就很不喜悦，说：「何用这样的枉费呢！
26.en: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?

26.zh: 这[香膏]可以卖许多钱，周济穷人。」
26.en: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor.”

26.zh: 耶稣看出他们的意思，就说：「为什么难为这女人呢？她在我身上做的是一件美事。
26.en: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.

26.zh: 因为常有穷人和你们同在；只是你们不常有我。
26.en: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.

26.zh: 她将这香膏浇在我身上是为我安葬做的。
26.en: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

26.zh: 我实在告诉你们，普天之下，无论在什么地方传这福音，也要述说这女人所行的，作个纪念。」
26.en: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”

26.zh: 当下，十二门徒里有一个称为加略人犹大的，去见祭司长，
26.en: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests

26.zh: 说：「我把他交给你们，你们愿意给我多少钱？」他们就给了他三十块钱。
26.en: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

26.zh: 从那时候，他就找机会要把耶稣交给他们。
26.en: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

26.zh: 除酵节的第一天，门徒来问耶稣说：「你吃逾越[节的筵席]，要我们在哪里给你预备？」
26.en: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”

26.zh: 耶稣说：「你们进城去，到某人那里，对他说：『夫子说：我的时候快到了，我与门徒要在你家里守逾越[节]。』」
26.en: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”

26.zh: 门徒遵着耶稣所吩咐的就去预备了逾越[节的筵席]。
26.en: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

26.zh: 到了晚上，耶稣和十二个门徒坐席。
26.en: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

26.zh: 正吃的时候，耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，你们中间有一个人要卖我了。」
26.en: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

26.zh: 他们就甚忧愁，一个一个地问他说：「主，是我吗？」
26.en: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”

26.zh: 耶稣回答说：「同我蘸手在盘子里的，就是他要卖我。
26.en: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

26.zh: 人子必要去世，正如[经上]指着他所写的；但卖人子的人有祸了！那人不生在世上倒好。」
26.en: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

26.zh: 卖耶稣的犹大问他说：「拉比，是我吗？」耶稣说：「你说的是。」
26.en: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”

26.zh: 他们吃的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝福，就擘开，递给门徒，说：「你们拿着吃，这是我的身体」；
26.en: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”

26.zh: 又拿起杯来，祝谢了，递给他们，说：「你们都喝这个；
26.en: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,

26.zh: 因为这是我立约的血，为多人流出来，使罪得赦。
26.en: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

26.zh: 但我告诉你们，从今以后，我不再喝这葡萄汁，直到我在我父的国里同你们喝新的那日子。」
26.en: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”

26.zh: 他们唱了诗，就出来往橄榄山去。
26.en: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

26.zh: 那时，耶稣对他们说：「今夜，你们为我的缘故都要跌倒。因为[经上]记着说： 我要击打牧人， 羊就分散了。
26.en: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

26.zh: 但我复活以后，要在你们以先往加利利去。」
26.en: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

26.zh: 彼得说：「众人虽然为你的缘故跌倒，我却永不跌倒。」
26.en: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”

26.zh: 耶稣说：「我实在告诉你，今夜鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。」
26.en: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”

26.zh: 彼得说：「我就是必须和你同死，也总不能不认你。」众门徒都是这样说。
26.en: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.

26.zh: 耶稣同门徒来到一个地方，名叫客西马尼，就对他们说：「你们坐在这里，等我到那边去祷告。」
26.en: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”

26.zh: 于是带着彼得和西庇太的两个儿子同去，就忧愁起来，极其难过，
26.en: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

26.zh: 便对他们说：「我心里甚是忧伤，几乎要死；你们在这里等候，和我一同警醒。」
26.en: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”

26.zh: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，祷告说：「我父啊，倘若可行，求你叫这杯离开我。然而，不要照我的意思，只要照你的意思。」
26.en: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

26.zh: 来到门徒那里，见他们睡着了，就对彼得说：「怎么样？你们不能同我警醒片时吗？
26.en: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?

26.zh: 总要警醒祷告，免得入了迷惑。你们心灵固然愿意，肉体却软弱了。」
26.en: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

26.zh: 第二次又去祷告说：「我父啊，这杯若不能离开我，必要我喝，就愿你的意旨成全。」
26.en: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”

26.zh: 又来，见他们睡着了，因为他们的眼睛困倦。
26.en: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

26.zh: 耶稣又离开他们去了。第三次祷告，说的话还是与先前一样。
26.en: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

26.zh: 于是来到门徒那里，对他们说：「现在你们仍然睡觉安歇吧！时候到了，人子被卖在罪人手里了。
26.en: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

26.zh: 起来！我们走吧。看哪，卖我的人近了！」
26.en: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

26.zh: 说话之间，那十二个门徒里的犹大来了，并有许多人带着刀棒，从祭司长和民间的长老那里与他同来。
26.en: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

26.zh: 那卖耶稣的给了他们一个暗号，说：「我与谁亲嘴，谁就是他。你们可以拿住他。」
26.en: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”

26.zh: 犹大随即到耶稣跟前，说：「请拉比安」，就与他亲嘴。
26.en: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

26.zh: 耶稣对他说：「朋友，你来要做的事，就做吧。」于是那些人上前，下手拿住耶稣。
26.en: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

26.zh: 有跟随耶稣的一个人伸手拔出刀来，将大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉了他一个耳朵。
26.en: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

26.zh: 耶稣对他说：「收刀入鞘吧！凡动刀的，必死在刀下。
26.en: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

26.zh: 你想，我不能求我父现在为我差遣十二营多天使来吗？
26.en: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

26.zh: 若是这样，经上所说，事情必须如此的话怎么应验呢？」
26.en: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”

26.zh: 当时，耶稣对众人说：「你们带着刀棒出来拿我，如同拿强盗吗？我天天坐在殿里教训人，你们并没有拿我。
26.en: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.

26.zh: 但这一切的事成就了，为要应验先知书上的话。」当下，门徒都离开他，逃走了。
26.en: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.

26.zh: 拿耶稣的人把他带到大祭司该亚法那里去；文士和长老已经在那里聚会。
26.en: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

26.zh: 彼得远远地跟着耶稣，直到大祭司的院子，进到里面，就和差役同坐，要看这事到底怎样。
26.en: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

26.zh: 祭司长和全公会寻找假见证控告耶稣，要治死他。
26.en: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,

26.zh: 虽有好些人来作假见证，总得不着实据。末后有两个人前来，说：
26.en: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward

26.zh: 「这个人曾说：『我能拆毁　神的殿，三日内又建造起来。』」
26.en: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”

26.zh: 大祭司就站起来，对耶稣说：「你什么都不回答吗？这些人作见证告你的是什么呢？」
26.en: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”

26.zh: 耶稣却不言语。大祭司对他说：「我指着永生　神叫你起誓告诉我们，你是　神的儿子基督不是？」
26.en: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”

26.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你说的是。然而，我告诉你们，后来你们要看见人子坐在那权能者的右边，驾着天上的云降临。」
26.en: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”

26.zh: 大祭司就撕开衣服，说：「他说了僭妄的话，我们何必再用见证人呢？这僭妄的话，现在你们都听见了。
26.en: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

26.zh: 你们的意见如何？」他们回答说：「他是该死的。」
26.en: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”

26.zh: 他们就吐唾沫在他脸上，用拳头打他，也有用手掌打他的，说：
26.en: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

26.zh: 「基督啊！你是先知，告诉我们打你的是谁？」
26.en: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”

26.zh: 彼得在外面院子里坐着，有一个使女前来，说：「你素来也是同那加利利人耶稣一伙的。」
26.en: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”

26.zh: 彼得在众人面前却不承认，说：「我不知道你说的是什么！」
26.en: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”

26.zh: 既出去，到了门口，又有一个[使女]看见他，就对那里的人说：「这个人也是同拿撒勒人耶稣一伙的。」
26.en: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

26.zh: 彼得又不承认，并且起誓说：「我不认得那个人。」
26.en: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”

26.zh: 过了不多的时候，旁边站着的人前来，对彼得说：「你真是他们一党的，你的口音把你露出来了。」
26.en: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”

26.zh: 彼得就发咒起誓地说：「我不认得那个人。」立时，鸡就叫了。
26.en: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.

26.zh: 彼得想起耶稣所说的话：「鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。」他就出去痛哭。
26.en: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.

27.zh: 到了早晨，众祭司长和民间的长老大家商议要治死耶稣，
27.en: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

27.zh: 就把他捆绑，解去，交给巡抚彼拉多。
27.en: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

27.zh: 这时候，卖耶稣的犹大看见耶稣已经定了罪，就后悔，把那三十块钱拿回来给祭司长和长老，说：
27.en: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

27.zh: 「我卖了无辜之人的血是有罪了。」他们说：「那与我们有什么相干？你自己承当吧！」
27.en: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

27.zh: 犹大就把那银钱丢在殿里，出去吊死了。
27.en: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.

27.zh: 祭司长拾起银钱来，说：「这是血价，不可放在库里。」
27.en: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

27.zh: 他们商议，就用那银钱买了窑户的一块田，为要埋葬外乡人。
27.en: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

27.zh: 所以那块田直到今日还叫做「血田」。
27.en: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

27.zh: 这就应了先知耶利米的话，说：「他们用那三十块钱，就是被估定之人的价钱，是以色列人中所估定的，
27.en: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,

27.zh: 买了窑户的一块田；这是照着主所吩咐我的。」
27.en: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

27.zh: 耶稣站在巡抚面前；巡抚问他说：「你是犹太人的王吗？」耶稣说：「你说的是。」
27.en: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”

27.zh: 他被祭司长和长老控告的时候，什么都不回答。
27.en: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

27.zh: 彼拉多就对他说：「他们作见证告你这么多的事，你没有听见吗？」
27.en: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

27.zh: 耶稣仍不回答，连一句话也不说，以致巡抚甚觉希奇。
27.en: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

27.zh: 巡抚有一个常例，每逢这节期，随众人所要的释放一个囚犯给他们。
27.en: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

27.zh: 当时有一个出名的囚犯叫巴拉巴。
27.en: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

27.zh: 众人聚集的时候，彼拉多就对他们说：「你们要我释放哪一个给你们？是巴拉巴呢？是称为基督的耶稣呢？」
27.en: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

27.zh: 巡抚原知道他们是因为嫉妒才把他解了来。
