27.en: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

27.zh: 正坐堂的时候，他的夫人打发人来说：「这义人的事，你一点不可管，因为我今天在梦中为他受了许多的苦。」
27.en: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

27.zh: 祭司长和长老挑唆众人，求释放巴拉巴，除灭耶稣。
27.en: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

27.zh: 巡抚对众人说：「这两个人，你们要我释放哪一个给你们呢？」他们说：「巴拉巴。」
27.en: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

27.zh: 彼拉多说：「这样，那称为基督的耶稣我怎么办他呢？」他们都说：「把他钉十字架！」
27.en: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

27.zh: 巡抚说：「为什么呢？他做了什么恶事呢？」他们便极力地喊着说：「把他钉十字架！」
27.en: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

27.zh: 彼拉多见说也无济于事，反要生乱，就拿水在众人面前洗手，说：「流这义人的血，罪不在我，你们承当吧。」
27.en: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

27.zh: 众人都回答说：「他的血归到我们和我们的子孙身上。」
27.en: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”

27.zh: 于是彼拉多释放巴拉巴给他们，把耶稣鞭打了，交给人钉十字架。
27.en: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

27.zh: 巡抚的兵就把耶稣带进衙门，叫全营的兵都聚集在他那里。
27.en: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

27.zh: 他们给他脱了衣服，穿上一件朱红色袍子，
27.en: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

27.zh: 用荆棘编做冠冕，戴在他头上，拿一根苇子放在他右手里，跪在他面前，戏弄他，说：「恭喜，犹太人的王啊！」
27.en: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

27.zh: 又吐唾沫在他脸上，拿苇子打他的头。
27.en: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

27.zh: 戏弄完了，就给他脱了袍子，仍穿上他自己的衣服，带他出去，要钉十字架。
27.en: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

27.zh: 他们出来的时候，遇见一个古利奈人，名叫西门，就勉强他同去，好背着耶稣的十字架。
27.en: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

27.zh: 到了一个地方名叫各各他，意思就是「髑髅地」。
27.en: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

27.zh: 兵丁拿苦胆调和的酒给耶稣喝；他尝了，就不肯喝。
27.en: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

27.zh: 他们既将他钉在十字架上，就拈阄分他的衣服，
27.en: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

27.zh: 又坐在那里看守他。
27.en: and they sat and watched him there.

27.zh: 在他头以上安一个牌子，写着他的罪状，说：「这是犹太人的王耶稣。」
27.en: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

27.zh: 当时，有两个强盗和他同钉十字架，一个在右边，一个在左边。
27.en: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

27.zh: 从那里经过的人讥诮他，摇着头，说：
27.en: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads

27.zh: 「你这拆毁[圣]殿、三日又建造起来的，可以救自己吧！你如果是　神的儿子，就从十字架上下来吧！」
27.en: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

27.zh: 祭司长和文士并长老也是这样戏弄他，说：
27.en: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

27.zh: 「他救了别人，不能救自己。他是以色列的王，现在可以从十字架上下来，我们就信他。
27.en: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

27.zh: 他倚靠　神，　神若喜悦他，现在可以救他；因为他曾说：『我是　神的儿子。』」
27.en: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

27.zh: 那和他同钉的强盗也是这样地讥诮他。
27.en: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

27.zh: 从午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。
27.en: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

27.zh: 约在申初，耶稣大声喊着说：「以利！以利！拉马撒巴各大尼？」就是说：「我的　神！我的　神！为什么离弃我？」
27.en: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

27.zh: 站在那里的人，有的听见就说：「这个人呼叫以利亚呢！」
27.en: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

27.zh: 内中有一个人赶紧跑去，拿海绒蘸满了醋，绑在苇子上，送给他喝。
27.en: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

27.zh: 其余的人说：「且等着，看以利亚来救他不来。」
27.en: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

27.zh: 耶稣又大声喊叫，气就断了。
27.en: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

27.zh: 忽然，殿里的幔子从上到下裂为两半，地也震动，磐石也崩裂，
27.en: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

27.zh: 坟墓也开了，已睡圣徒的身体多有起来的。
27.en: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

27.zh: 到耶稣复活以后，他们从坟墓里出来，进了圣城，向许多人显现。
27.en: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

27.zh: 百夫长和一同看守耶稣的人看见地震并所经历的事，就极其害怕，说：「这真是　神的儿子了！」
27.en: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”

27.zh: 有好些妇女在那里，远远地观看；她们是从加利利跟随耶稣来服事他的。
27.en: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

27.zh: 内中有抹大拉的马利亚，又有雅各和约西的母亲马利亚，并有西庇太两个儿子的母亲。
27.en: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

27.zh: 到了晚上，有一个财主，名叫约瑟，是亚利马太来的，他也是耶稣的门徒。
27.en: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

27.zh: 这人去见彼拉多，求耶稣的身体；彼拉多就吩咐给他。
27.en: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

27.zh: 约瑟取了身体，用干净细麻布裹好，
27.en: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

27.zh: 安放在自己的新坟墓里，就是他凿在磐石里的。他又把大石头滚到墓门口，就去了。
27.en: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

27.zh: 有抹大拉的马利亚和那个马利亚在那里，对着坟墓坐着。
27.en: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

27.zh: 次日，就是预备日的第二天，祭司长和法利赛人聚集来见彼拉多，说：
27.en: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

27.zh: 「大人，我们记得那诱惑人的还活着的时候曾说：『三日后我要复活。』
27.en: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

27.zh: 因此，请吩咐人将坟墓把守妥当，直到第三日，恐怕他的门徒来，把他偷了去，就告诉百姓说：『他从死里复活了。』这样，那后来的迷惑比先前的更利害了！」
27.en: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

27.zh: 彼拉多说：「你们有看守的兵，去吧！尽你们所能的把守妥当。」
27.en: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

27.zh: 他们就带着看守的兵同去，封了石头，将坟墓把守妥当。
27.en: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

28.zh: 安息日将尽，七日的头一日，天快亮的时候，抹大拉的马利亚和那个马利亚来看坟墓。
28.en: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

28.zh: 忽然，地大震动；因为有主的使者从天上下来，把石头滚开，坐在上面。
28.en: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

28.zh: 他的相貌如同闪电，衣服洁白如雪。
28.en: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

28.zh: 看守的人就因他吓得浑身乱战，甚至和死人一样。
28.en: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

28.zh: 天使对妇女说：「不要害怕！我知道你们是寻找那钉十字架的耶稣。
28.en: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

28.zh: 他不在这里，照他所说的，已经复活了。你们来看安放主的地方。
28.en: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

28.zh: 快去告诉他的门徒，说他从死里复活了，并且在你们以先往加利利去，在那里你们要见他。看哪，我已经告诉你们了。」
28.en: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

28.zh: 妇女们就急忙离开坟墓，又害怕，又大大地欢喜，跑去要报给他的门徒。
28.en: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

28.zh: 忽然，耶稣遇见她们，说：「愿你们平安！」她们就上前抱住他的脚拜他。
28.en: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

28.zh: 耶稣对她们说：「不要害怕！你们去告诉我的弟兄，叫他们往加利利去，在那里必见我。」
28.en: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

28.zh: 她们去的时候，看守的兵有几个进城去，将所经历的事都报给祭司长。
28.en: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

28.zh: 祭司长和长老聚集商议，就拿许多银钱给兵丁，说：
28.en: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

28.zh: 「你们要这样说：『夜间我们睡觉的时候，他的门徒来，把他偷去了。』
28.en: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

28.zh: 倘若这话被巡抚听见，有我们劝他，保你们无事。」
28.en: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

28.zh: 兵丁受了银钱，就照所嘱咐他们的去行。这话就传说在犹太人中间，直到今日。
28.en: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

28.zh: 十一个门徒往加利利去，到了耶稣约定的山上。
28.en: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

28.zh: 他们见了耶稣就拜他，然而还有人疑惑。
28.en: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

28.zh: 耶稣进前来，对他们说：「天上地下所有的权柄都赐给我了。
28.en: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

28.zh: 所以，你们要去，使万民作我的门徒，奉父、子、圣灵的名给他们施洗。
28.en: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

28.zh: 凡我所吩咐你们的，都教训他们遵守，我就常与你们同在，直到世界的末了。」
28.en: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
